recipes.title: Huevos Rancheros
recipes.ingredients:
6 corn tortillas
1 tbsp oil
1 can (15 oz) black beans, drained
1 cup salsa
6 eggs
1/2 cup shredded cheese
1/4 cup chopped cilantro
1 avocado, sliced
recipes.instructions:
Warm the black beans in a small saucepan with a splash of water; mash lightly.
Heat oil in a skillet and lightly fry the tortillas until just crisp at the edges.
In the same skillet, warm the salsa over medium heat.
Fry the eggs sunny-side up in a separate pan.
Spread beans on each tortilla, top with a fried egg and warm salsa.
Sprinkle with cheese and cilantro, and serve with avocado slices.

recipes.title: Dutch Baby Pancake
recipes.ingredients:
3 eggs
1/2 cup flour
1/2 cup milk
2 tbsp sugar
1/4 tsp salt
1 tsp vanilla extract
3 tbsp butter
Powdered sugar and lemon wedges for serving
recipes.instructions:
Preheat oven to 425F with a cast iron skillet inside.
Blend eggs, flour, milk, sugar, salt, and vanilla until smooth.
Carefully add butter to the hot skillet until melted and foaming.
Pour batter into the skillet and bake 18-20 minutes until puffed and golden.
Dust with powdered sugar and serve immediately with lemon wedges.

recipes.title: Sourdough French Toast Bake
recipes.ingredients:
6 cups cubed sourdough bread
4 eggs
1 1/2 cups milk
1/3 cup brown sugar
1 tsp cinnamon
1 tsp vanilla extract
2 tbsp butter, melted
Maple syrup for serving
recipes.instructions:
Grease a baking dish and add the cubed bread.
Whisk eggs, milk, brown sugar, cinnamon, and vanilla together and pour over the bread.
Press bread down to soak, cover, and refrigerate at least 1 hour or overnight.
Preheat oven to 350F and drizzle melted butter over the top.
Bake uncovered for 40-45 minutes until puffed and golden.
Serve warm with maple syrup.

recipes.title: Breakfast Enchiladas
recipes.ingredients:
8 small flour tortillas
8 eggs, scrambled soft
1 cup diced ham
1 cup shredded cheddar
1 cup enchilada sauce
2 tbsp chopped green onion
recipes.instructions:
Preheat oven to 375F.
Fill each tortilla with scrambled eggs, ham, and a little cheese, then roll and place seam-side down in a baking dish.
Pour enchilada sauce evenly over the top and sprinkle with remaining cheese.
Bake 20-25 minutes until bubbly.
Garnish with green onion before serving.

recipes.title: Migas with Tortilla Strips
recipes.ingredients:
1 tbsp oil
1 cup crushed tortilla chips
8 eggs, beaten
1/2 cup diced tomato
1/4 cup diced onion
1/2 cup shredded cheese
2 tbsp chopped cilantro
recipes.instructions:
Heat oil in a nonstick skillet over medium heat and cook onion until soft.
Add tomato and cook 2 minutes.
Stir in tortilla chips, then pour in beaten eggs.
Cook, stirring gently, until eggs are just set.
Fold in cheese and cilantro, and serve immediately.

recipes.title: Steel-Cut Oats with Maple and Pecans
recipes.ingredients:
1 cup steel-cut oats
3 cups water or milk
1/4 tsp salt
3 tbsp maple syrup
1/2 cup toasted pecans, chopped
1 tsp cinnamon
recipes.instructions:
Bring water or milk to a boil with salt.
Stir in the oats, reduce heat, and simmer uncovered 20-25 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Remove from heat and stir in maple syrup and cinnamon.
Top with toasted pecans before serving.

recipes.title: Breakfast Skillet Nachos
recipes.ingredients:
4 cups tortilla chips
6 eggs, scrambled
1/2 cup cooked breakfast sausage, crumbled
1 cup shredded cheese
1/2 cup salsa
1/4 cup sour cream
2 tbsp sliced green onion
recipes.instructions:
Preheat oven to 400F.
Spread tortilla chips on an oven-safe skillet or sheet pan.
Scatter scrambled eggs, sausage, and cheese over the chips.
Bake 8-10 minutes until cheese melts.
Top with salsa, sour cream, and green onion before serving.

recipes.title: Cheese Blintzes
recipes.ingredients:
6 crepes
1 cup ricotta cheese
4 oz cream cheese, softened
3 tbsp sugar
1 egg yolk
1 tsp vanilla extract
2 tbsp butter
Fruit preserves for serving
recipes.instructions:
Mix ricotta, cream cheese, sugar, egg yolk, and vanilla until smooth.
Spoon filling onto each crepe and fold into a rectangle, tucking in the ends.
Melt butter in a skillet over medium heat.
Cook blintzes seam-side down until golden, then flip and brown the other side.
Serve warm with fruit preserves.

recipes.title: Buckwheat Crepes with Berries
recipes.ingredients:
1 cup buckwheat flour
2 eggs
1 1/4 cups milk
1 tbsp melted butter
Pinch of salt
2 cups mixed berries
2 tbsp honey
recipes.instructions:
Whisk buckwheat flour, eggs, milk, butter, and salt until smooth; rest batter 10 minutes.
Heat a lightly greased nonstick pan over medium heat.
Pour a thin layer of batter, swirl to coat, and cook 1-2 minutes per side.
Warm the berries with honey in a small saucepan until slightly softened.
Fill crepes with berry mixture and fold to serve.

recipes.title: Sausage Gravy and Biscuits
recipes.ingredients:
6 refrigerated biscuits, baked
1/2 lb breakfast sausage
3 tbsp flour
2 cups milk
1/2 tsp salt
1/4 tsp black pepper
recipes.instructions:
Bake biscuits according to package directions.
Brown the sausage in a skillet over medium heat, breaking it into crumbles.
Sprinkle flour over the sausage and cook 1 minute, stirring.
Gradually whisk in milk and simmer until thickened, about 5 minutes.
Season with salt and pepper and spoon over split biscuits.

recipes.title: Breakfast Bibimbap
recipes.ingredients:
2 cups cooked rice
1 cup julienned carrots
1 cup baby spinach, sauteed
1 cup bean sprouts, blanched
1 cup shredded zucchini, sauteed
3 eggs, fried
2 tbsp gochujang
1 tbsp sesame oil
Sesame seeds for garnish
recipes.instructions:
Divide rice among three bowls.
Arrange carrots, spinach, sprouts, and zucchini in sections over the rice.
Top each bowl with a fried egg.
Drizzle with gochujang and sesame oil.
Sprinkle with sesame seeds and mix well before eating.

recipes.title: Congee with Soft-Boiled Egg
recipes.ingredients:
3/4 cup jasmine rice
6 cups chicken broth
1 tbsp grated ginger
3 soft-boiled eggs, halved
2 green onions, sliced
1 tsp sesame oil
Soy sauce to taste
recipes.instructions:
Rinse rice and combine with broth and ginger in a pot.
Bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer uncovered, stirring occasionally, 40-45 minutes until thick and creamy.
Season with soy sauce to taste.
Ladle into bowls and top with a soft-boiled egg, green onion, and a drizzle of sesame oil.

recipes.title: Spanish Tortilla (Potato Omelet)
recipes.ingredients:
4 tbsp olive oil
4 medium potatoes, thinly sliced
1 onion, thinly sliced
6 eggs
1 tsp salt
1/4 tsp black pepper
recipes.instructions:
Heat olive oil in a nonstick skillet and cook potatoes and onion over low heat until tender, about 20 minutes.
Drain potatoes and onion, reserving the oil, and let cool slightly.
Whisk eggs with salt and pepper, then fold in the potatoes and onion.
Add a little reserved oil back to the skillet and pour in the egg mixture over low heat.
Cook until mostly set, then invert onto a plate and slide back into the pan to finish the other side.
Slice into wedges and serve warm or at room temperature.

recipes.title: Breakfast Naan Wrap
recipes.ingredients:
3 pieces naan bread
6 eggs, scrambled
1/2 cup diced cooked potatoes
1/4 cup chopped onion
1/2 tsp garam masala
1/2 cup shredded cheese
Cilantro chutney for serving
recipes.instructions:
Warm naan in a dry skillet or oven.
Scramble eggs with potatoes, onion, and garam masala until just set.
Spoon egg mixture down the center of each naan and top with cheese.
Roll up tightly and serve with cilantro chutney.

recipes.title: Pumpkin Spice Pancakes
recipes.ingredients:
1 1/2 cups flour
2 tbsp brown sugar
2 tsp baking powder
1 1/2 tsp pumpkin pie spice
1/2 tsp salt
1 1/4 cups milk
1/2 cup pumpkin puree
1 egg
2 tbsp melted butter
recipes.instructions:
Whisk flour, brown sugar, baking powder, pumpkin pie spice, and salt in a bowl.
In another bowl, whisk milk, pumpkin puree, egg, and melted butter.
Combine wet and dry ingredients, stirring just until mixed.
Cook 1/4 cup portions on a greased griddle until bubbles form, then flip.
Serve warm with maple syrup.

recipes.title: Cornbread Waffles with Honey Butter
recipes.ingredients:
1 cup cornmeal
1 cup flour
2 tbsp sugar
1 tbsp baking powder
1/2 tsp salt
1 3/4 cups buttermilk
2 eggs
4 tbsp melted butter
2 tbsp honey, softened with 2 tbsp butter
recipes.instructions:
Whisk cornmeal, flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
Whisk buttermilk, eggs, and melted butter together and stir into the dry ingredients.
Cook in a preheated waffle iron until golden and crisp.
Mix honey with softened butter and serve alongside the waffles.

recipes.title: Baked Apple Oatmeal Cups
recipes.ingredients:
2 cups rolled oats
1 apple, diced
1/3 cup brown sugar
1 tsp cinnamon
1 tsp baking powder
1/4 tsp salt
1 1/4 cups milk
1 egg
2 tbsp melted coconut oil
recipes.instructions:
Preheat oven to 350F and line a muffin tin with liners.
Combine oats, diced apple, brown sugar, cinnamon, baking powder, and salt in a bowl.
Whisk milk, egg, and coconut oil together and stir into the dry mixture.
Divide batter among muffin cups and bake 18-20 minutes until set.
Cool slightly before serving.

recipes.title: Breakfast Chilaquiles
recipes.ingredients:
4 cups tortilla chips
1 1/2 cups red or green salsa
3 eggs, fried
1/2 cup crumbled queso fresco
1/4 cup sour cream
2 tbsp chopped cilantro
1/4 cup diced onion
recipes.instructions:
Warm the salsa in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add tortilla chips and toss gently to coat, cooking 2-3 minutes until slightly softened but still crisp in places.
Divide among plates and top each with a fried egg.
Sprinkle with queso fresco, onion, and cilantro, and finish with a dollop of sour cream.

recipes.title: Muesli with Fresh Fruit
recipes.ingredients:
1 1/2 cups rolled oats
1/4 cup sliced almonds
1/4 cup dried cranberries
1 tbsp chia seeds
2 cups milk or yogurt
1 apple, grated
1 cup mixed fresh berries
Honey to taste
recipes.instructions:
Combine oats, almonds, cranberries, and chia seeds in a bowl.
Stir in milk or yogurt and grated apple.
Cover and refrigerate at least 2 hours or overnight.
Top with fresh berries and a drizzle of honey before serving.

recipes.title: English Muffin Breakfast Pizzas
recipes.ingredients:
3 English muffins, split
1/2 cup pizza sauce
1 cup shredded mozzarella
6 eggs
1/2 cup cooked crumbled sausage
Dried oregano to taste
recipes.instructions:
Preheat oven to 400F and place split muffins on a baking sheet.
Spread each half with pizza sauce and top with mozzarella and sausage.
Bake 8 minutes, then crack an egg onto each half.
Return to the oven and bake 4-5 minutes more until eggs are set to your liking.
Sprinkle with oregano before serving.

recipes.title: Ricotta Pancakes with Lemon
recipes.ingredients:
1 cup ricotta cheese
3 eggs, separated
1/2 cup flour
2 tbsp sugar
Zest of 1 lemon
1/4 tsp salt
Butter for the pan
recipes.instructions:
Whisk ricotta, egg yolks, flour, sugar, lemon zest, and salt until smooth.
Beat egg whites to soft peaks and fold into the batter gently.
Cook 1/4 cup portions in a buttered skillet over medium-low heat until golden, flipping once.
Serve warm with extra lemon zest or a dusting of powdered sugar.

recipes.title: Bacon and Egg Fried Rice
recipes.ingredients:
3 cups cooked, cold rice
4 slices bacon, chopped
3 eggs, beaten
1 cup diced carrots, cooked
1/2 cup frozen shelled edamame, cooked
2 green onions, sliced
2 tbsp soy sauce
1 tsp sesame oil
recipes.instructions:
Cook bacon in a large skillet or wok until crisp; remove and set aside, leaving the fat in the pan.
Scramble the eggs in the same pan and set aside.
Add rice to the pan, breaking up clumps, and stir-fry 3-4 minutes.
Return bacon and eggs to the pan with carrots and edamame; stir in soy sauce and sesame oil.
Toss everything together until heated through and garnish with green onion.

recipes.title: Cinnamon Roll Bake
recipes.ingredients:
2 cans refrigerated cinnamon rolls with icing
4 eggs
3/4 cup milk
1 tsp vanilla extract
1/4 cup brown sugar
1/2 tsp cinnamon
recipes.instructions:
Preheat oven to 350F and cut cinnamon rolls into quarters, placing in a greased baking dish.
Whisk eggs, milk, vanilla, brown sugar, and cinnamon together and pour over the rolls.
Let sit 10 minutes to soak.
Bake 22-25 minutes until set and golden.
Drizzle with the reserved icing before serving.

recipes.title: Breakfast Potato Skins
recipes.ingredients:
3 russet potatoes, baked and halved
4 eggs, scrambled
1/2 cup shredded cheddar
3 slices bacon, cooked and crumbled
2 tbsp sour cream
1 tbsp chopped chives
recipes.instructions:
Scoop most of the flesh out of the baked potato halves, leaving a thin shell.
Fill each shell with scrambled eggs and top with cheese and bacon.
Bake at 400F for 8-10 minutes until cheese melts.
Top with sour cream and chives before serving.

recipes.title: Savory Oatmeal with Fried Egg and Spinach
recipes.ingredients:
1 cup rolled oats
2 1/2 cups vegetable broth
2 cups baby spinach
3 eggs, fried
1/4 cup shredded parmesan
Red pepper flakes to taste
recipes.instructions:
Bring vegetable broth to a boil and stir in oats.
Simmer 8-10 minutes, stirring occasionally, until creamy.
Stir in spinach until wilted.
Divide oatmeal among bowls and top each with a fried egg and parmesan.
Finish with a pinch of red pepper flakes.

recipes.title: Breakfast Stuffed Sweet Potatoes
recipes.ingredients:
3 medium sweet potatoes
3 eggs
1/4 cup black beans
1/4 cup shredded cheese
1 tbsp chopped green onion
Salsa for serving
recipes.instructions:
Pierce sweet potatoes and bake at 400F for 35-40 minutes until tender.
Slice each potato open and fluff the inside slightly.
Fry or scramble the eggs.
Fill each potato with black beans, eggs, and cheese.
Top with green onion and a spoonful of salsa.

recipes.title: Cheddar Scallion Biscuits
recipes.ingredients:
2 cups flour
1 tbsp baking powder
1/2 tsp salt
6 tbsp cold butter, cubed
1 cup shredded cheddar
3 scallions, sliced
3/4 cup buttermilk
recipes.instructions:
Preheat oven to 425F.
Whisk flour, baking powder, and salt, then cut in butter until crumbly.
Stir in cheddar and scallions, then add buttermilk and mix just until a dough forms.
Pat dough to 1-inch thickness and cut into rounds.
Bake on a lined sheet 15-18 minutes until golden.

recipes.title: Apple Cider Donut Muffins
recipes.ingredients:
1 3/4 cups flour
1 tsp baking powder
1/2 tsp baking soda
1 tsp cinnamon
1/2 tsp nutmeg
1/2 cup sugar
1/2 cup apple cider
1/3 cup melted butter
1 egg
1/2 tsp vanilla extract
3 tbsp melted butter and cinnamon sugar for topping
recipes.instructions:
Preheat oven to 375F and line a muffin tin.
Whisk flour, baking powder, baking soda, cinnamon, and nutmeg together.
In another bowl whisk sugar, cider, melted butter, egg, and vanilla.
Combine wet and dry ingredients until just mixed and divide among muffin cups.
Bake 18-20 minutes, then brush warm muffins with melted butter and roll in cinnamon sugar.

recipes.title: Breakfast Chicken Sausage Patties
recipes.ingredients:
1 lb ground chicken
1 tsp dried sage
1/2 tsp garlic powder
1/2 tsp salt
1/4 tsp black pepper
1 tbsp maple syrup
1 tbsp oil for cooking
recipes.instructions:
Combine ground chicken, sage, garlic powder, salt, pepper, and maple syrup in a bowl.
Shape into small patties.
Heat oil in a skillet over medium heat and cook patties 5-6 minutes per side until cooked through.
Serve warm alongside eggs or toast.

recipes.title: Egg in a Basket
recipes.ingredients:
3 slices bread
3 eggs
1 tbsp butter
Salt and pepper to taste
Shredded cheese, optional
recipes.instructions:
Cut a hole in the center of each bread slice with a cup or cookie cutter.
Melt butter in a skillet over medium heat and place the bread slices in the pan.
Crack an egg into the hole of each slice.
Cook 2-3 minutes, then flip carefully and cook 1-2 minutes more.
Season with salt and pepper and serve warm.

recipes.title: Breakfast Rice Pudding
recipes.ingredients:
1 cup cooked rice
2 cups milk
3 tbsp sugar
1/2 tsp vanilla extract
1/4 tsp cinnamon
1/4 cup raisins
recipes.instructions:
Combine rice, milk, sugar, and raisins in a saucepan.
Simmer over low heat, stirring often, 25-30 minutes until thickened and creamy.
Stir in vanilla and cinnamon.
Serve warm or chilled.

recipes.title: Croque Madame
recipes.ingredients:
6 slices sandwich bread
6 slices deli ham
1 1/2 cups shredded gruyere cheese
3 tbsp butter
3 tbsp flour
1 1/2 cups milk
3 eggs, fried
recipes.instructions:
Melt 2 tbsp butter in a saucepan, whisk in flour, then gradually add milk to make a smooth bechamel; season with salt.
Assemble sandwiches with ham and half the cheese, then grill in butter until golden on both sides.
Top each sandwich with bechamel and remaining cheese, then broil until bubbly.
Top each sandwich with a fried egg and serve immediately.

recipes.title: Waffle Breakfast Sliders with Sausage
recipes.ingredients:
6 small frozen waffles, toasted
6 breakfast sausage patties, cooked
3 tbsp maple syrup
6 slices cheddar cheese
recipes.instructions:
Toast waffles until golden and crisp.
Cook sausage patties according to package directions and top each with a slice of cheese to melt.
Assemble sliders with a sausage patty between two waffle halves.
Drizzle with maple syrup before serving.

recipes.title: Breakfast Barley Bowl with Fruit and Nuts
recipes.ingredients:
1 cup pearl barley
3 cups milk
2 tbsp honey
1 tsp cinnamon
1 cup sliced strawberries
1/4 cup chopped walnuts
recipes.instructions:
Combine barley and milk in a saucepan and bring to a simmer.
Cook uncovered over low heat, stirring occasionally, 30-35 minutes until tender and creamy.
Stir in honey and cinnamon.
Divide among bowls and top with strawberries and walnuts.

recipes.title: Ham and Cheese Crepes
recipes.ingredients:
6 crepes
6 slices deli ham
1 cup shredded gruyere or swiss cheese
2 tbsp butter
1 tbsp chopped chives
recipes.instructions:
Lay a crepe flat and place a slice of ham and a handful of cheese in the center.
Fold the crepe into quarters.
Melt butter in a skillet over medium heat and cook folded crepes until golden and cheese melts, about 2 minutes per side.
Garnish with chives and serve warm.

recipes.title: Cuban Sandwich (Cubano)
recipes.ingredients:
1 loaf Cuban or French bread, split
6 oz sliced roast pork
6 oz sliced deli ham
4 slices swiss cheese
1/4 cup yellow mustard
6 dill pickle slices
2 tbsp softened butter
recipes.instructions:
Spread mustard on both cut sides of the bread.
Layer roast pork, ham, cheese, and pickles on the bottom half and close the sandwich.
Butter the outside of the bread.
Press the sandwich in a hot skillet or panini press until golden and the cheese melts, about 4-5 minutes per side.
Slice on the diagonal and serve.

recipes.title: Vietnamese-Style Pork Banh Mi
recipes.ingredients:
1 baguette, cut into 3 pieces
1/2 lb thinly sliced pork, marinated in soy sauce and garlic
1 carrot, julienned and quick-pickled
1 daikon radish, julienned and quick-pickled
1/4 cup mayonnaise
Fresh cilantro sprigs
1 jalapeno, sliced
Soy sauce to taste
recipes.instructions:
Cook the marinated pork in a hot skillet until browned and cooked through.
Split the baguette pieces and spread with mayonnaise.
Layer pork, pickled carrot and daikon, jalapeno, and cilantro inside each roll.
Drizzle with a little extra soy sauce and serve.

recipes.title: Greek-Style Chicken Salad with Feta and Cucumber
recipes.ingredients:
2 cups chopped cooked chicken
1 cucumber, diced
1 cup halved cherry tomatoes
1/2 red onion, thinly sliced
1/2 cup crumbled feta
3 tbsp olive oil
1 tbsp red wine vinegar
1 tsp dried oregano
Salt and pepper to taste
recipes.instructions:
Combine chicken, cucumber, tomatoes, and red onion in a large bowl.
Whisk olive oil, vinegar, oregano, salt, and pepper together.
Pour dressing over the salad and toss to coat.
Top with crumbled feta and serve chilled.

recipes.title: Thai Peanut Noodle Salad
recipes.ingredients:
8 oz rice noodles, cooked
1/3 cup peanut butter
2 tbsp soy sauce
2 tbsp rice vinegar
1 tbsp honey
1 tsp grated ginger
1 carrot, julienned
1 cup shredded cabbage
1/4 cup chopped peanuts
2 tbsp chopped cilantro
recipes.instructions:
Whisk peanut butter, soy sauce, rice vinegar, honey, and ginger with a splash of warm water until smooth.
Toss cooked noodles with carrot and cabbage in a large bowl.
Pour the peanut dressing over and toss to coat.
Top with chopped peanuts and cilantro before serving.

recipes.title: Cuban-Style Black Bean Soup
recipes.ingredients:
2 tbsp olive oil
1 onion, diced
2 carrots, diced
3 cloves garlic, minced
2 cans (15 oz) black beans, drained
3 cups vegetable broth
1 tsp dried oregano
1 bay leaf
1 tbsp red wine vinegar
Sour cream and chopped onion for serving
recipes.instructions:
Heat oil in a pot and cook onion and carrots until softened, about 6 minutes.
Add garlic and cook 1 minute more.
Stir in black beans, broth, oregano, and bay leaf; bring to a simmer.
Cook uncovered 25-30 minutes, then remove bay leaf.
Puree half the soup with an immersion blender for a creamier texture, then stir in vinegar.
Serve with sour cream and chopped onion.

recipes.title: Chicken Shawarma Bowl
recipes.ingredients:
1 lb chicken thighs, cubed
2 tsp paprika
1 tsp garlic powder
1/2 tsp turmeric
1/2 tsp cinnamon
2 tbsp olive oil
2 cups cooked rice
1 cup chopped romaine
1 cucumber, diced
1/2 cup plain yogurt
1 tbsp lemon juice
1 clove garlic, minced
recipes.instructions:
Toss chicken with paprika, garlic powder, turmeric, cinnamon, and olive oil.
Cook chicken in a hot skillet until browned and cooked through, about 10 minutes.
Mix yogurt, lemon juice, and minced garlic for the sauce.
Divide rice among bowls and top with chicken, romaine, and cucumber.
Drizzle with the yogurt sauce before serving.

recipes.title: Falafel Pita Sandwich
recipes.ingredients:
1 can (15 oz) chickpeas, drained
1/4 cup chopped parsley
3 cloves garlic
1 tsp ground coriander
1/2 tsp baking powder
2 tbsp flour
Oil for frying
3 pita breads
1 cup shredded lettuce
1 tomato, sliced
1/3 cup tahini sauce
recipes.instructions:
Pulse chickpeas, parsley, garlic, coriander, baking powder, and flour in a food processor until a coarse paste forms.
Shape into small patties.
Fry patties in a shallow layer of hot oil until golden and crisp, about 3 minutes per side.
Warm the pitas and fill with falafel, lettuce, and tomato.
Drizzle with tahini sauce and serve.

recipes.title: Reuben Sandwich
recipes.ingredients:
6 slices rye bread
3/4 lb sliced corned beef
1 1/2 cups sauerkraut, drained
6 slices swiss cheese
1/3 cup Thousand Island dressing
2 tbsp butter, softened
recipes.instructions:
Spread dressing on one side of each bread slice.
Layer corned beef, sauerkraut, and cheese between two slices, dressing sides in.
Butter the outside of the sandwiches.
Grill in a skillet over medium heat until golden and cheese melts, about 3-4 minutes per side.
Slice and serve warm.

recipes.title: French Dip Sandwich au Jus
recipes.ingredients:
3 crusty rolls, split
3/4 lb thinly sliced roast beef
3 slices provolone cheese
2 cups beef broth
1 tsp Worcestershire sauce
1 clove garlic, smashed
recipes.instructions:
Simmer beef broth with Worcestershire sauce and garlic in a small pot for 10 minutes to make the jus.
Warm the sliced roast beef in the broth briefly.
Pile beef onto rolls and top with provolone; melt under a broiler if desired.
Serve each sandwich with a small cup of the warm jus for dipping.

recipes.title: Turkey and Cranberry Panini
recipes.ingredients:
6 slices sourdough bread
3/4 lb sliced turkey breast
1/3 cup cranberry sauce
6 slices brie cheese
2 tbsp butter, softened
recipes.instructions:
Spread cranberry sauce on three slices of bread.
Layer turkey and brie on top, then close with the remaining bread slices.
Butter the outside of each sandwich.
Grill in a panini press or skillet until golden and cheese melts, about 3-4 minutes per side.
Slice in half and serve warm.

recipes.title: Cream of Mushroom Soup
recipes.ingredients:
2 tbsp butter
1 lb mushrooms, sliced
1 onion, diced
2 cloves garlic, minced
3 tbsp flour
3 cups vegetable broth
1 cup milk
1/4 cup heavy cream
Salt and pepper to taste
Fresh thyme for garnish
recipes.instructions:
Melt butter in a pot and cook mushrooms and onion until softened and browned, about 10 minutes.
Add garlic and cook 1 minute.
Sprinkle in flour and stir to coat, cooking 1 minute.
Gradually whisk in broth, then simmer 15 minutes.
Stir in milk and cream, and season with salt and pepper.
Garnish with fresh thyme and serve hot.

recipes.title: Butternut Squash Soup
recipes.ingredients:
1 small butternut squash, peeled and cubed
1 onion, chopped
2 carrots, chopped
3 cups vegetable broth
1/2 tsp cinnamon
1/4 tsp nutmeg
1/4 cup heavy cream
2 tbsp olive oil
recipes.instructions:
Heat oil in a pot and cook onion and carrots until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add squash, broth, cinnamon, and nutmeg; bring to a boil.
Simmer 25-30 minutes until squash is very tender.
Puree with an immersion blender until smooth.
Stir in cream and adjust seasoning before serving.

recipes.title: Corn and Potato Chowder
recipes.ingredients:
2 tbsp butter
1 onion, diced
2 potatoes, diced
2 cups fresh or frozen corn kernels
3 cups vegetable broth
1 cup milk
1/2 cup heavy cream
Salt and pepper to taste
2 slices bacon, cooked and crumbled
recipes.instructions:
Melt butter in a pot and cook onion until soft, about 5 minutes.
Add potatoes, corn, and broth; bring to a boil and simmer 15-20 minutes until potatoes are tender.
Mash some of the potatoes against the pot to thicken slightly.
Stir in milk and cream and heat through without boiling.
Season with salt and pepper and top with crumbled bacon.

recipes.title: Chicken Tortellini Soup
recipes.ingredients:
1 tbsp olive oil
1 onion, diced
2 carrots, diced
2 celery stalks, diced
6 cups chicken broth
2 cups shredded cooked chicken
9 oz cheese tortellini
2 cups baby spinach
Grated parmesan for serving
recipes.instructions:
Heat oil in a pot and cook onion, carrots, and celery until softened, about 6 minutes.
Add broth and bring to a boil.
Stir in tortellini and cook according to package directions.
Add chicken and spinach, and simmer until spinach wilts and chicken is warmed through.
Serve topped with parmesan.

recipes.title: Pork and Vegetable Wonton Soup
recipes.ingredients:
24 wonton wrappers
1/2 lb ground pork
1/4 cup finely chopped napa cabbage
1 tsp grated ginger
1 tbsp soy sauce
1 tsp sesame oil
6 cups chicken broth
2 green onions, sliced
1 cup baby bok choy, chopped
recipes.instructions:
Mix ground pork, cabbage, ginger, soy sauce, and sesame oil in a bowl.
Place a small spoonful of filling in each wonton wrapper, moisten edges, and fold into triangles, pressing to seal.
Bring chicken broth to a simmer and add bok choy.
Drop wontons into the simmering broth and cook 4-5 minutes until they float and filling is cooked through.
Ladle into bowls and garnish with green onion.

recipes.title: Egg Drop Soup
recipes.ingredients:
4 cups vegetable or chicken broth
1 tbsp cornstarch mixed with 2 tbsp water
2 eggs, beaten
1 tsp sesame oil
2 green onions, sliced
White pepper to taste
recipes.instructions:
Bring broth to a simmer in a pot.
Stir in the cornstarch slurry and cook until slightly thickened.
Slowly drizzle in the beaten eggs while stirring gently in one direction to create ribbons.
Remove from heat and stir in sesame oil and white pepper.
Garnish with green onion before serving.

recipes.title: Hot and Sour Soup
recipes.ingredients:
4 cups chicken broth
1/2 cup sliced mushrooms
1/2 cup diced firm tofu
2 tbsp soy sauce
3 tbsp rice vinegar
1/2 tsp white pepper
1 tbsp cornstarch mixed with 2 tbsp water
1 egg, beaten
2 green onions, sliced
recipes.instructions:
Bring broth to a simmer with mushrooms and tofu.
Stir in soy sauce, rice vinegar, and white pepper.
Add the cornstarch slurry and simmer until slightly thickened.
Drizzle in beaten egg while stirring gently.
Garnish with green onion and serve hot.

recipes.title: Chicken Ramen Noodle Soup
recipes.ingredients:
6 cups chicken broth
1 tbsp soy sauce
1 tbsp miso paste
2 cloves garlic, minced
1 tsp grated ginger
2 packs ramen noodles
2 cups shredded cooked chicken
3 soft-boiled eggs, halved
2 green onions, sliced
1 cup baby spinach
recipes.instructions:
Simmer broth with soy sauce, miso, garlic, and ginger for 10 minutes.
Cook ramen noodles according to package directions and drain.
Divide noodles among bowls and ladle hot broth over them.
Top with shredded chicken, spinach, soft-boiled egg, and green onion.

recipes.title: Vietnamese Beef Noodle Soup (Pho-Style)
recipes.ingredients:
6 cups beef broth
1 cinnamon stick
2 star anise pods
1 onion, halved
1 lb thinly sliced beef sirloin
8 oz rice noodles, cooked
1 cup bean sprouts
1/4 cup chopped cilantro
1 lime, cut into wedges
Sriracha for serving
recipes.instructions:
Char the onion under a broiler until softened, then add to the broth with cinnamon stick and star anise.
Simmer the broth 30-35 minutes, then strain.
Divide cooked noodles among bowls and top with raw sliced beef.
Ladle the very hot broth over the beef to cook it.
Top with bean sprouts, cilantro, and lime, and serve with sriracha.

recipes.title: Panzanella (Tuscan Bread Salad)
recipes.ingredients:
4 cups cubed day-old bread
4 tomatoes, chopped
1 cucumber, diced
1/2 red onion, thinly sliced
1/4 cup fresh basil, torn
1/4 cup olive oil
2 tbsp red wine vinegar
Salt and pepper to taste
recipes.instructions:
Toast the bread cubes in a 375F oven for 8-10 minutes until crisp.
Combine tomatoes, cucumber, onion, and basil in a large bowl.
Whisk olive oil, vinegar, salt, and pepper and pour over the vegetables.
Add the toasted bread and toss well.
Let sit 10 minutes before serving so the bread soaks up the dressing.

recipes.title: Waldorf Chicken Salad
recipes.ingredients:
2 cups chopped cooked chicken
1 apple, diced
1 cup halved red grapes
1/2 cup diced celery
1/3 cup chopped walnuts
1/3 cup mayonnaise
1 tbsp lemon juice
Salt and pepper to taste
recipes.instructions:
Combine chicken, apple, grapes, celery, and walnuts in a large bowl.
Whisk mayonnaise and lemon juice together and fold into the salad.
Season with salt and pepper.
Chill 20 minutes before serving, over greens or as a sandwich filling.

recipes.title: Southwestern Black Bean Wrap
recipes.ingredients:
3 large flour tortillas
1 can (15 oz) black beans, drained and mashed slightly
1 cup corn kernels
1/2 cup diced tomato
1/4 cup shredded cheese
1/4 cup chopped cilantro
1/3 cup sour cream
1 tsp chili powder
recipes.instructions:
Mix black beans with chili powder and warm slightly if desired.
Spread beans down the center of each tortilla.
Top with corn, tomato, cheese, and cilantro.
Add a dollop of sour cream, then roll tightly into a wrap.
Slice in half and serve.

recipes.title: Turkey Club Wrap
recipes.ingredients:
3 large flour tortillas
9 oz sliced turkey breast
6 slices bacon, cooked
1 cup shredded lettuce
1 tomato, sliced
1/3 cup mayonnaise
3 slices cheddar cheese
recipes.instructions:
Spread mayonnaise over each tortilla.
Layer turkey, bacon, cheese, lettuce, and tomato in the center.
Fold in the sides and roll tightly.
Slice in half on the diagonal and serve.

recipes.title: Chicken Gyro Sandwich
recipes.ingredients:
1 lb chicken thighs, sliced thin
2 tsp dried oregano
1 tsp garlic powder
2 tbsp olive oil
3 pita breads
1 cup shredded lettuce
1 tomato, sliced
1/2 red onion, sliced
1/2 cup tzatziki sauce
recipes.instructions:
Toss chicken with oregano, garlic powder, and olive oil.
Cook in a hot skillet until browned and cooked through, about 8-10 minutes.
Warm the pitas briefly in a dry skillet.
Fill each pita with chicken, lettuce, tomato, and onion.
Drizzle with tzatziki sauce and serve.

recipes.title: Cajun Chicken Sandwich
recipes.ingredients:
3 chicken breasts, pounded thin
2 tsp Cajun seasoning
1 tbsp oil
3 brioche buns
3 lettuce leaves
3 tomato slices
1/3 cup spicy mayonnaise
recipes.instructions:
Season chicken breasts with Cajun seasoning on both sides.
Heat oil in a skillet and cook chicken 5-6 minutes per side until cooked through.
Toast the buns lightly.
Spread spicy mayonnaise on the buns and assemble with chicken, lettuce, and tomato.

recipes.title: BBQ Pulled Chicken Sandwiches
recipes.ingredients:
1 lb boneless chicken thighs
1 cup barbecue sauce
1/2 cup chicken broth
3 brioche buns
1 cup coleslaw mix
2 tbsp mayonnaise
1 tbsp apple cider vinegar
recipes.instructions:
Simmer chicken thighs in broth and half the barbecue sauce, covered, for 20-25 minutes until very tender.
Shred the chicken and stir in remaining barbecue sauce.
Toss coleslaw mix with mayonnaise and vinegar.
Pile pulled chicken onto buns and top with coleslaw.

recipes.title: Ham and White Bean Soup
recipes.ingredients:
1 tbsp olive oil
1 onion, diced
2 carrots, diced
2 celery stalks, diced
2 cans (15 oz) white beans, drained
1 1/2 cups diced cooked ham
4 cups chicken broth
1 bay leaf
1/2 tsp dried thyme
recipes.instructions:
Heat oil in a pot and cook onion, carrots, and celery until softened, about 6 minutes.
Add beans, ham, broth, bay leaf, and thyme.
Bring to a boil, then simmer 25-30 minutes.
Remove bay leaf, mash some beans against the pot to thicken slightly, and serve hot.

recipes.title: Chicken Salad Lettuce Wraps
recipes.ingredients:
2 cups chopped cooked chicken
1/3 cup mayonnaise
1 tbsp Dijon mustard
1/2 cup diced celery
1/4 cup dried cranberries
8 large butter lettuce leaves
recipes.instructions:
Combine chicken, mayonnaise, mustard, celery, and cranberries in a bowl.
Mix well and season with salt and pepper.
Spoon chicken salad into lettuce leaves.
Fold and serve immediately.

recipes.title: Kimchi Fried Rice Bowl
recipes.ingredients:
3 cups cooked, cold rice
1 cup chopped kimchi
2 tbsp kimchi juice
2 tbsp gochujang
1 tbsp sesame oil
3 eggs, fried
2 green onions, sliced
Sesame seeds for garnish
recipes.instructions:
Heat sesame oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat.
Add kimchi and cook 2-3 minutes until fragrant.
Add rice, kimchi juice, and gochujang, and stir-fry 5-6 minutes until well combined and slightly crisp.
Divide among bowls and top each with a fried egg.
Garnish with green onion and sesame seeds.

recipes.title: Antipasto Salad
recipes.ingredients:
4 cups chopped romaine
4 oz sliced salami, cut into strips
4 oz fresh mozzarella pearls
1 cup cherry tomatoes, halved
1/2 cup marinated artichoke hearts
1/4 cup roasted red onion
3 tbsp olive oil
1 tbsp red wine vinegar
1 tsp dried oregano
recipes.instructions:
Combine romaine, salami, mozzarella, tomatoes, artichoke hearts, and onion in a large bowl.
Whisk olive oil, vinegar, and oregano together.
Pour dressing over the salad and toss well.
Serve immediately.

recipes.title: Chickpea Salad Sandwich
recipes.ingredients:
1 can (15 oz) chickpeas, drained and mashed
1/3 cup mayonnaise
1 tbsp Dijon mustard
1 celery stalk, diced
2 tbsp diced red onion
1 tbsp lemon juice
6 slices whole wheat bread
Lettuce leaves for serving
recipes.instructions:
Mash chickpeas in a bowl, leaving some texture.
Stir in mayonnaise, mustard, celery, onion, and lemon juice.
Season with salt and pepper.
Spread onto bread with lettuce and top with the second slice.

recipes.title: German-Style Potato Salad with Sausage
recipes.ingredients:
4 medium potatoes, cubed
3 smoked sausages, sliced
4 slices bacon, chopped
1/2 onion, diced
3 tbsp apple cider vinegar
1 tbsp Dijon mustard
1 tsp sugar
2 tbsp chopped fresh parsley
recipes.instructions:
Boil potatoes in salted water until tender, about 12-15 minutes, then drain.
Cook bacon in a skillet until crisp; remove and set aside, leaving fat in the pan.
Cook sausage slices and onion in the bacon fat until browned.
Whisk vinegar, mustard, and sugar together and toss with the warm potatoes, sausage, onion, and bacon.
Garnish with parsley and serve warm.

recipes.title: Curried Lentil Soup
recipes.ingredients:
1 tbsp oil
1 onion, diced
2 cloves garlic, minced
1 tbsp grated ginger
1 tbsp curry powder
1 cup red lentils, rinsed
4 cups vegetable broth
1 carrot, diced
1/2 cup coconut milk
Fresh cilantro for garnish
recipes.instructions:
Heat oil in a pot and cook onion until soft, about 5 minutes.
Add garlic, ginger, and curry powder, cooking 1 minute until fragrant.
Stir in lentils, broth, and carrot; bring to a boil.
Simmer uncovered 20-25 minutes until lentils are soft.
Stir in coconut milk and simmer 5 more minutes.
Garnish with cilantro before serving.

recipes.title: Buffalo Ranch Turkey Wrap
recipes.ingredients:
3 large flour tortillas
9 oz sliced turkey breast
1/3 cup buffalo sauce
1/3 cup ranch dressing
1 cup shredded lettuce
1/2 cup shredded carrots
1/4 cup crumbled blue cheese
recipes.instructions:
Toss the turkey slices with buffalo sauce.
Spread ranch dressing over each tortilla.
Layer turkey, lettuce, carrots, and blue cheese in the center.
Roll tightly, slice in half, and serve.

recipes.title: Loaded Ground Beef Nacho Bowl
recipes.ingredients:
1 lb ground beef
1 packet taco seasoning
4 cups tortilla chips
1 cup shredded cheese
1/2 cup black beans
1/2 cup diced tomato
1/4 cup sliced jalapeno
1/3 cup sour cream
2 tbsp chopped cilantro
recipes.instructions:
Brown the ground beef in a skillet, then stir in taco seasoning and a splash of water; simmer 5 minutes.
Divide tortilla chips among bowls.
Top with seasoned beef, cheese, black beans, tomato, and jalapeno.
Finish with sour cream and cilantro.

recipes.title: Chicken Caprese Sandwich
recipes.ingredients:
3 chicken breasts, pounded thin
2 tbsp balsamic glaze
3 ciabatta rolls
6 slices fresh mozzarella
2 tomatoes, sliced
Fresh basil leaves
2 tbsp olive oil
recipes.instructions:
Season chicken with salt and pepper and cook in olive oil over medium heat until browned and cooked through, about 5-6 minutes per side.
Toast the ciabatta rolls.
Assemble sandwiches with chicken, mozzarella, tomato, and basil.
Drizzle with balsamic glaze before closing the sandwich and serving.

recipes.title: Egg and Potato Salad Bowl
recipes.ingredients:
3 potatoes, cubed and boiled
4 hard-boiled eggs, chopped
1/3 cup mayonnaise
1 tbsp Dijon mustard
2 tbsp diced red onion
1 celery stalk, diced
Salt and pepper to taste
Paprika for garnish
recipes.instructions:
Boil potatoes until fork-tender, about 12-15 minutes, then cool slightly.
Combine potatoes, eggs, onion, and celery in a bowl.
Whisk mayonnaise and mustard together and fold into the salad.
Season with salt and pepper and chill before serving, garnished with paprika.

recipes.title: Chicken Caesar Pasta Salad
recipes.ingredients:
8 oz rotini pasta, cooked
2 cups chopped cooked chicken
2 cups chopped romaine
1/3 cup grated parmesan
1/2 cup Caesar dressing
1/2 cup croutons, roughly crushed
recipes.instructions:
Cook pasta according to package directions, drain, and cool slightly.
Combine pasta, chicken, and romaine in a large bowl.
Toss with Caesar dressing and parmesan.
Top with crushed croutons just before serving.

recipes.title: Smoked Sausage and Potato Soup
recipes.ingredients:
1 tbsp oil
1 smoked sausage ring, sliced
1 onion, diced
3 potatoes, cubed
4 cups chicken broth
1 cup milk
2 cups chopped kale
Salt and pepper to taste
recipes.instructions:
Heat oil in a pot and brown the sausage slices; remove and set aside.
Cook onion in the same pot until soft.
Add potatoes and broth, bring to a boil, and simmer 15-20 minutes until potatoes are tender.
Stir in sausage, milk, and kale, and simmer 5 more minutes until kale wilts.
Season with salt and pepper and serve hot.

recipes.title: Turkey Meatball Sub
recipes.ingredients:
1 lb ground turkey
1/3 cup breadcrumbs
1 egg
2 tbsp grated parmesan
1 tsp dried oregano
2 cups marinara sauce
3 sub rolls
1 cup shredded mozzarella
recipes.instructions:
Preheat oven to 400F.
Mix turkey, breadcrumbs, egg, parmesan, and oregano, then shape into meatballs.
Bake meatballs 15-18 minutes until cooked through.
Simmer meatballs in marinara sauce for 5 minutes.
Split the rolls, fill with meatballs and sauce, top with mozzarella, and broil until melted.

recipes.title: Chicken Katsu with Rice
recipes.ingredients:
3 boneless chicken breasts, pounded thin
1/2 cup flour
2 eggs, beaten
1 1/2 cups panko breadcrumbs
Oil for frying
2 cups cooked rice
1/2 cup katsu or barbecue sauce
1/4 head cabbage, shredded
recipes.instructions:
Season chicken with salt and pepper.
Dredge in flour, then egg, then panko, pressing to coat.
Fry in about 1/2 inch of hot oil until golden and cooked through, 3-4 minutes per side.
Slice and serve over rice with shredded cabbage and katsu sauce drizzled on top.

recipes.title: Beef Bulgogi
recipes.ingredients:
1 lb thinly sliced beef sirloin
1/4 cup soy sauce
2 tbsp brown sugar
1 tbsp sesame oil
3 cloves garlic, minced
1 tsp grated ginger
1 pear, grated
2 cups cooked rice
2 green onions, sliced
Sesame seeds for garnish
recipes.instructions:
Whisk soy sauce, brown sugar, sesame oil, garlic, ginger, and grated pear together.
Marinate the beef in the mixture for at least 20 minutes.
Cook beef in a hot skillet in batches until browned, about 2-3 minutes per side.
Serve over rice, garnished with green onion and sesame seeds.

recipes.title: Chicken Tikka Masala
recipes.ingredients:
1 lb chicken thighs, cubed
1/2 cup plain yogurt
1 tbsp lemon juice
2 tsp paprika
1 tbsp oil
1 onion, diced
3 cloves garlic, minced
1 tbsp grated ginger
1 tsp garam masala
1/2 tsp turmeric
1 can (15 oz) tomato sauce
1/2 cup heavy cream
2 cups cooked rice
recipes.instructions:
Marinate chicken in yogurt, lemon juice, and paprika for at least 15 minutes.
Heat oil in a pan and cook chicken until browned; remove and set aside.
In the same pan, cook onion until soft, then add garlic, ginger, garam masala, and turmeric.
Stir in tomato sauce and simmer 10 minutes.
Return chicken to the pan and simmer until cooked through, about 10 minutes.
Stir in cream and serve over rice.

recipes.title: Beef and Vegetable Curry
recipes.ingredients:
1 lb beef stew meat, cubed
1 tbsp oil
1 onion, diced
3 cloves garlic, minced
1 tbsp grated ginger
2 tsp curry powder
1/2 tsp turmeric
1 can (15 oz) diced tomatoes
1 cup beef broth
2 carrots, sliced
1 potato, cubed
1/2 cup coconut milk
2 cups cooked rice
recipes.instructions:
Heat oil in a pot and brown the beef in batches; set aside.
Cook onion until soft, then add garlic, ginger, curry powder, and turmeric.
Return beef to the pot with tomatoes and broth; bring to a simmer.
Cover and cook 25 minutes, then add carrots and potato and cook 15-20 more minutes until tender.
Stir in coconut milk and serve over rice.

recipes.title: Pad Thai with Chicken
recipes.ingredients:
8 oz rice noodles
1 lb chicken breast, sliced thin
2 eggs, beaten
1/4 cup tamarind-style sauce (tamarind paste, soy sauce, brown sugar, lime juice)
2 cloves garlic, minced
1 cup bean sprouts
3 green onions, chopped
1/3 cup chopped peanuts
Lime wedges for serving
recipes.instructions:
Soak rice noodles in warm water until pliable, about 20 minutes, then drain.
Heat a wok over high heat and cook chicken until browned and cooked through; push to one side.
Scramble the eggs in the empty side of the wok.
Add noodles, garlic, and the tamarind-style sauce, tossing to combine.
Stir in bean sprouts and green onions and cook 2 minutes more.
Top with chopped peanuts and serve with lime wedges.

recipes.title: Beef Vindaloo
recipes.ingredients:
1 lb beef stew meat, cubed
1 tbsp oil
1 onion, diced
4 cloves garlic, minced
1 tbsp grated ginger
2 tsp paprika
1 tsp ground coriander
1/2 tsp cinnamon
2 tbsp red wine vinegar
1 can (15 oz) diced tomatoes
1 cup beef broth
2 cups cooked rice
recipes.instructions:
Heat oil in a pot and brown the beef in batches; set aside.
Cook onion until softened, then add garlic, ginger, paprika, coriander, and cinnamon.
Stir in vinegar, tomatoes, and broth, then return beef to the pot.
Cover and simmer 40-45 minutes until beef is tender.
Serve over rice.

recipes.title: Chicken Adobo
recipes.ingredients:
8 chicken thighs
1/2 cup soy sauce
1/2 cup white vinegar
6 cloves garlic, smashed
1 bay leaf
1/2 tsp black peppercorns
1 tbsp brown sugar
2 cups cooked rice
recipes.instructions:
Combine chicken, soy sauce, vinegar, garlic, bay leaf, peppercorns, and brown sugar in a pot.
Bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer covered 20 minutes.
Uncover and simmer 10-15 more minutes until sauce thickens and chicken is tender.
Serve over rice with sauce spooned on top.

recipes.title: Beef Bourguignon
recipes.ingredients:
1 1/2 lb beef chuck, cubed
4 slices bacon, chopped
1 onion, diced
2 carrots, sliced
2 cloves garlic, minced
2 tbsp flour
1 1/2 cups red wine
1 1/2 cups beef broth
1 cup mushrooms, quartered
1 tbsp tomato paste
1 bay leaf
Mashed potatoes for serving
recipes.instructions:
Cook bacon in a Dutch oven until crisp; remove and set aside.
Brown the beef in the bacon fat in batches; set aside.
Cook onion and carrots until softened, then add garlic and flour, stirring 1 minute.
Stir in tomato paste, wine, and broth, then return beef and bacon to the pot with the bay leaf.
Cover and simmer on low, or bake at 325F, for 1 1/2 hours until beef is fork-tender.
Stir in mushrooms for the last 20 minutes of cooking.
Serve over mashed potatoes.

recipes.title: Coq au Vin
recipes.ingredients:
6 chicken thighs
4 slices bacon, chopped
1 onion, diced
2 carrots, sliced
2 cloves garlic, minced
2 tbsp flour
1 1/2 cups red wine
1 cup chicken broth
1 cup mushrooms, sliced
1 bay leaf
Fresh thyme sprigs
recipes.instructions:
Cook bacon in a Dutch oven until crisp; remove and set aside.
Brown chicken thighs in the bacon fat, then remove.
Cook onion and carrots until soft, then stir in garlic and flour.
Add wine and broth, then return chicken and bacon to the pot with bay leaf and thyme.
Cover and simmer 40-45 minutes until chicken is very tender.
Stir in mushrooms for the last 15 minutes and serve.

recipes.title: Chicken Paprikash
recipes.ingredients:
6 chicken thighs
2 tbsp oil
1 onion, diced
2 tbsp paprika
2 cups chicken broth
1 can (15 oz) diced tomatoes
1/2 cup sour cream
2 tbsp flour
Egg noodles, cooked, for serving
recipes.instructions:
Heat oil in a pan and brown chicken thighs; remove and set aside.
Cook onion until soft, then stir in paprika and cook 30 seconds.
Add broth and tomatoes, then return chicken to the pan.
Cover and simmer 30-35 minutes until chicken is cooked through.
Whisk sour cream and flour together, stir into the sauce, and simmer until thickened.
Serve over egg noodles.

recipes.title: Beef and Broccoli Noodle Stir-Fry
recipes.ingredients:
8 oz lo mein noodles, cooked
1 lb flank steak, thinly sliced
2 cups broccoli florets
3 tbsp soy sauce
1 tbsp mushroom stir-fry sauce
1 tbsp cornstarch
2 cloves garlic, minced
1 tbsp grated ginger
2 tbsp oil
recipes.instructions:
Toss beef with 1 tbsp soy sauce and cornstarch.
Heat oil in a wok over high heat and stir-fry beef until browned; remove.
Stir-fry broccoli with garlic and ginger 3-4 minutes until crisp-tender.
Return beef to the wok with noodles, remaining soy sauce, and mushroom sauce.
Toss everything together until heated through and serve.

recipes.title: General Tso's Chicken
recipes.ingredients:
1 lb chicken thighs, cubed
1/2 cup cornstarch
Oil for frying
3 tbsp soy sauce
2 tbsp rice vinegar
3 tbsp brown sugar
1 tbsp hoisin sauce
2 cloves garlic, minced
1 tsp grated ginger
Red pepper flakes to taste
2 cups cooked rice
2 green onions, sliced
recipes.instructions:
Toss chicken pieces in cornstarch to coat.
Fry chicken in batches in hot oil until golden and crisp; drain on paper towels.
Whisk soy sauce, rice vinegar, brown sugar, and hoisin sauce together.
Saute garlic, ginger, and red pepper flakes in a clean pan, then add the sauce and simmer until thickened.
Toss fried chicken in the sauce and serve over rice, garnished with green onion.

recipes.title: Sesame Chicken
recipes.ingredients:
1 lb chicken breast, cubed
1/2 cup cornstarch
Oil for frying
1/4 cup soy sauce
3 tbsp honey
2 tbsp rice vinegar
1 tbsp sesame oil
2 cloves garlic, minced
1 tbsp sesame seeds
2 cups cooked rice
recipes.instructions:
Toss chicken in cornstarch and fry in hot oil until golden; drain.
Whisk soy sauce, honey, rice vinegar, sesame oil, and garlic in a saucepan and simmer until thickened.
Toss fried chicken in the sauce until coated.
Sprinkle with sesame seeds and serve over rice.

recipes.title: Beef Tostadas
recipes.ingredients:
6 tostada shells
1 lb ground beef
1 packet taco seasoning
1 can (15 oz) refried beans, warmed
1 cup shredded lettuce
1 cup shredded cheese
1 tomato, diced
1/2 cup sour cream
recipes.instructions:
Brown ground beef in a skillet, then stir in taco seasoning and a splash of water; simmer 5 minutes.
Spread warmed refried beans onto each tostada shell.
Top with seasoned beef, lettuce, cheese, and tomato.
Finish with a dollop of sour cream and serve.

recipes.title: Pork Pozole Verde
recipes.ingredients:
1 1/2 lb pork shoulder, cubed
4 cups chicken broth
1 can (15 oz) hominy, drained
1 cup tomatillo salsa verde
1 onion, chopped
2 cloves garlic, minced
1 tsp dried oregano
Shredded cabbage, radish, and lime for serving
recipes.instructions:
Combine pork, broth, onion, garlic, and oregano in a large pot.
Bring to a boil, then simmer covered 50-60 minutes until pork is tender.
Stir in hominy and salsa verde, and simmer 10 more minutes.
Shred the pork slightly with two forks.
Serve topped with shredded cabbage, radish, and a squeeze of lime.

recipes.title: Chile Colorado Beef
recipes.ingredients:
1 1/2 lb beef stew meat
3 dried guajillo chiles, stemmed and seeded
2 cups beef broth
1 onion, chopped
3 cloves garlic
1 tsp dried oregano
1/2 tsp smoked paprika
2 cups cooked rice or warm tortillas
recipes.instructions:
Toast dried chiles briefly in a dry skillet, then soak in hot broth for 15 minutes.
Blend soaked chiles with broth, onion, and garlic until smooth.
Brown the beef in a pot, then pour in the chile sauce and oregano.
Cover and simmer 1 hour until beef is very tender.
Serve over rice or with warm tortillas.

recipes.title: Chicken Mole Skillet
recipes.ingredients:
6 chicken thighs
1 tbsp oil
1 onion, chopped
2 cloves garlic, minced
2 tbsp chili powder
1 tbsp cocoa powder
1 tsp cinnamon
1 can (15 oz) diced tomatoes
1 cup chicken broth
1 tbsp peanut butter
2 cups cooked rice
recipes.instructions:
Heat oil in a skillet and brown chicken thighs; remove and set aside.
Cook onion until soft, then add garlic, chili powder, cocoa powder, and cinnamon.
Stir in tomatoes, broth, and peanut butter, and simmer 5 minutes.
Return chicken to the skillet, cover, and simmer 25-30 minutes until cooked through.
Serve over rice.

recipes.title: Beef Birria Tacos
recipes.ingredients:
2 lb beef chuck roast, cubed
3 dried guajillo chiles
2 dried ancho chiles
1 onion, chopped
4 cloves garlic
1 tsp dried oregano
1 tsp smoked paprika
4 cups beef broth
Corn tortillas and shredded cheese for serving
recipes.instructions:
Toast the dried chiles in a dry skillet, then soak in hot water 15 minutes.
Blend soaked chiles with a little broth, onion, garlic, oregano, and paprika.
Combine beef, chile sauce, and remaining broth in a pot; bring to a boil.
Cover and simmer 1 3/4 to 2 hours until beef shreds easily.
Shred the beef and skim fat from the broth.
Dip tortillas in the broth, fill with beef and cheese, and griddle until crisp; serve with a cup of broth for dipping.

recipes.title: Chicken Tinga Tacos
recipes.ingredients:
1 lb shredded cooked chicken
1 tbsp oil
1 onion, sliced
2 cloves garlic, minced
1 can (15 oz) diced tomatoes
1 chipotle pepper in adobo, minced
1 tsp dried oregano
Corn tortillas, shredded lettuce, and queso fresco for serving
recipes.instructions:
Heat oil in a skillet and cook onion until soft.
Add garlic, tomatoes, chipotle, and oregano, and simmer 10 minutes.
Stir in shredded chicken and simmer 10 more minutes until well coated.
Warm the tortillas and fill with chicken tinga, lettuce, and queso fresco.

recipes.title: Chicken Chile Verde
recipes.ingredients:
1 1/2 lb chicken thighs, cubed
1 tbsp oil
1 onion, chopped
2 cloves garlic, minced
2 cups tomatillo salsa verde
1 cup chicken broth
1 tsp dried oregano
2 cups cooked rice or warm tortillas
recipes.instructions:
Heat oil in a pot and brown chicken; remove and set aside.
Cook onion until soft, then add garlic and cook 1 minute.
Stir in salsa verde, broth, and oregano; return chicken to the pot.
Cover and simmer 25-30 minutes until chicken is cooked through.
Serve over rice or with tortillas.

recipes.title: Jambalaya
recipes.ingredients:
1 tbsp oil
1 lb andouille sausage, sliced
1 lb chicken thighs, cubed
1 onion, diced
2 celery stalks, diced
2 cloves garlic, minced
1 can (15 oz) diced tomatoes
2 cups chicken broth
1 cup long-grain rice
2 tsp Cajun seasoning
2 green onions, sliced
recipes.instructions:
Heat oil in a large pot and brown sausage and chicken; remove and set aside.
Cook onion and celery until softened, then add garlic and cook 1 minute.
Stir in tomatoes, broth, rice, and Cajun seasoning.
Return sausage and chicken to the pot, bring to a boil, then cover and simmer 20-25 minutes until rice is tender.
Garnish with green onion before serving.

recipes.title: Cajun Blackened Chicken with Rice
recipes.ingredients:
3 chicken breasts
2 tbsp Cajun seasoning
2 tbsp oil
2 cups cooked rice
1 tbsp butter
2 tbsp chopped parsley
recipes.instructions:
Coat chicken breasts thoroughly with Cajun seasoning.
Heat oil in a heavy skillet over medium-high heat until very hot.
Sear chicken 5-6 minutes per side until blackened and cooked through.
Toss rice with butter and parsley.
Slice chicken and serve over the rice.

recipes.title: Cajun Sausage and Rice Skillet
recipes.ingredients:
1 tbsp oil
1 lb andouille sausage, sliced
1 onion, diced
2 celery stalks, diced
2 cloves garlic, minced
1 cup long-grain rice
2 1/2 cups chicken broth
1 can (15 oz) diced tomatoes
2 tsp Cajun seasoning
recipes.instructions:
Heat oil in a skillet and brown sausage slices; remove and set aside.
Cook onion and celery until softened, then add garlic.
Stir in rice, broth, tomatoes, and Cajun seasoning.
Return sausage to the skillet, cover, and simmer 20-25 minutes until rice is tender.

recipes.title: Chicken Etouffee
recipes.ingredients:
2 tbsp oil
2 tbsp flour
1 onion, diced
2 celery stalks, diced
1 carrot, diced
2 cloves garlic, minced
3 cups chicken broth
1 1/2 lb chicken thighs, cubed
2 tsp Cajun seasoning
2 cups cooked rice
recipes.instructions:
Heat oil in a pot, whisk in flour, and cook, stirring constantly, until deep golden brown, about 8-10 minutes.
Add onion, celery, and carrot, and cook until softened.
Stir in garlic, then gradually whisk in broth.
Add chicken and Cajun seasoning, and simmer 25-30 minutes until chicken is cooked through and sauce thickens.
Serve over rice.

recipes.title: Chicken and Sausage Gumbo
recipes.ingredients:
1/3 cup oil
1/3 cup flour
1 onion, diced
2 celery stalks, diced
1 lb andouille sausage, sliced
1 lb chicken thighs, cubed
4 cups chicken broth
2 tsp Cajun seasoning
2 cups cooked rice
Filé powder, optional
recipes.instructions:
Make a roux by whisking oil and flour together over medium heat, stirring constantly, until deep brown, about 15-20 minutes.
Add onion and celery and cook until softened.
Stir in sausage, chicken, broth, and Cajun seasoning.
Simmer uncovered 40-45 minutes, skimming any fat.
Serve over rice, with a pinch of filé powder if desired.

recipes.title: Chicken Marbella
recipes.ingredients:
6 chicken thighs
1/4 cup red wine vinegar
1/4 cup olive oil
4 cloves garlic, minced
2 tbsp capers
1/4 cup pitted prunes, chopped
2 tbsp brown sugar
1 tsp dried oregano
1/2 cup white wine
recipes.instructions:
Marinate chicken in vinegar, olive oil, garlic, capers, prunes, brown sugar, and oregano for at least 30 minutes.
Preheat oven to 375F and arrange chicken with marinade in a baking dish.
Pour white wine around the chicken.
Bake 40-45 minutes, basting occasionally, until chicken is cooked through and glazed.

recipes.title: Osso Buco-Style Braised Beef Shanks
recipes.ingredients:
3 beef shanks
2 tbsp flour
2 tbsp olive oil
1 onion, diced
1 carrot, diced
1 celery stalk, diced
1 cup white wine
2 cups beef broth
1 can (15 oz) diced tomatoes
Zest of 1 lemon
2 tbsp chopped parsley
recipes.instructions:
Dust beef shanks with flour and brown in olive oil in a Dutch oven; remove.
Cook onion, carrot, and celery until softened.
Add wine and simmer 2 minutes, then stir in broth and tomatoes.
Return shanks to the pot, cover, and braise at 325F for 1 3/4 to 2 hours until very tender.
Mix lemon zest with parsley and sprinkle over the shanks before serving.

recipes.title: Chicken Saltimbocca
recipes.ingredients:
3 chicken breasts, pounded thin
6 slices prosciutto
6 fresh sage leaves
2 tbsp flour
2 tbsp olive oil
1/2 cup white wine
1/2 cup chicken broth
2 tbsp butter
recipes.instructions:
Lay a sage leaf and a slice of prosciutto on each chicken piece, securing with a toothpick.
Dust lightly with flour.
Heat oil in a skillet and cook chicken, prosciutto side down first, until golden and cooked through, about 4 minutes per side.
Remove chicken, add wine and broth to the pan, and simmer to reduce slightly.
Whisk in butter, spoon sauce over chicken, and serve.

recipes.title: Chicken Piccata Meatballs over Pasta
recipes.ingredients:
1 lb ground chicken
1/3 cup breadcrumbs
1 egg
2 tbsp grated parmesan
2 tbsp lemon juice
2 tbsp capers
1 cup chicken broth
2 tbsp butter
8 oz spaghetti, cooked
recipes.instructions:
Preheat oven to 400F and mix ground chicken, breadcrumbs, egg, and parmesan; shape into meatballs.
Bake meatballs 18-20 minutes until cooked through.
Simmer lemon juice, capers, and broth in a skillet, then whisk in butter to make a sauce.
Toss meatballs and cooked spaghetti in the sauce and serve.

recipes.title: Baked Ziti with Meatballs
recipes.ingredients:
1 lb ziti pasta, cooked
1 lb frozen or homemade meatballs, cooked
3 cups marinara sauce
1 cup ricotta cheese
2 cups shredded mozzarella
1/4 cup grated parmesan
recipes.instructions:
Preheat oven to 375F.
Toss cooked ziti with marinara sauce and half the mozzarella.
Spread half the pasta in a baking dish, dot with ricotta, then top with meatballs.
Add remaining pasta and top with remaining mozzarella and parmesan.
Bake 25-30 minutes until bubbly and golden.

recipes.title: Eggplant Parmesan
recipes.ingredients:
1 large eggplant, sliced
1 cup flour
2 eggs, beaten
1 1/2 cups breadcrumbs
Oil for frying
2 cups marinara sauce
2 cups shredded mozzarella
1/4 cup grated parmesan
Fresh basil for garnish
recipes.instructions:
Salt eggplant slices and let sit 15 minutes, then pat dry.
Dredge slices in flour, egg, then breadcrumbs.
Fry in hot oil until golden on both sides; drain on paper towels.
Preheat oven to 375F and layer eggplant, marinara, and mozzarella in a baking dish, repeating layers.
Top with parmesan and bake 20-25 minutes until bubbly. Garnish with basil.

recipes.title: Chicken Milanese with Arugula Salad
recipes.ingredients:
3 chicken breasts, pounded thin
1/2 cup flour
2 eggs, beaten
1 1/2 cups breadcrumbs
1/4 cup grated parmesan
Oil for frying
3 cups arugula
1 tomato, diced
2 tbsp olive oil
1 tbsp lemon juice
recipes.instructions:
Dredge chicken in flour, egg, then breadcrumbs mixed with parmesan.
Fry in a shallow layer of hot oil until golden and cooked through, about 3-4 minutes per side.
Toss arugula and tomato with olive oil and lemon juice.
Top each cutlet with the arugula salad and serve.

recipes.title: Vegetable Paella-Style Rice
recipes.ingredients:
2 tbsp olive oil
1 onion, diced
2 cloves garlic, minced
1 1/2 cups short-grain rice
1/2 tsp smoked paprika
Pinch of saffron threads
3 cups vegetable broth
1 cup green beans, trimmed
1 cup diced zucchini
1 cup canned diced tomatoes
1 cup canned artichoke hearts, quartered
recipes.instructions:
Heat oil in a wide pan and cook onion until soft.
Add garlic, rice, paprika, and saffron, stirring to coat, about 1 minute.
Pour in broth and tomatoes, then arrange green beans, zucchini, and artichoke hearts over the top.
Bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer uncovered 20-25 minutes without stirring, until rice is tender and a crust forms on the bottom.
Let rest 5 minutes before serving.

recipes.title: Chicken and Chorizo Paella
recipes.ingredients:
2 tbsp olive oil
1 lb chicken thighs, cubed
1/2 lb Spanish chorizo, sliced
1 onion, diced
2 cloves garlic, minced
1 1/2 cups short-grain rice
Pinch of saffron threads
3 cups chicken broth
1 cup canned diced tomatoes
1 cup green beans, trimmed
recipes.instructions:
Heat oil in a wide pan and brown chicken and chorizo; remove and set aside.
Cook onion until soft, then add garlic and rice, stirring to coat.
Stir in saffron, broth, and tomatoes, then return chicken and chorizo to the pan.
Arrange green beans over the top, bring to a boil, then simmer uncovered 20-25 minutes without stirring.
Let rest 5 minutes before serving.

recipes.title: Beef Empanadas
recipes.ingredients:
12 empanada dough rounds
1 lb ground beef
1 onion, diced
2 cloves garlic, minced
1 tsp smoked paprika
1/2 tsp dried oregano
1/4 cup chopped golden raisins
1 egg, beaten for egg wash
recipes.instructions:
Preheat oven to 400F.
Cook ground beef with onion and garlic until browned; drain excess fat.
Stir in paprika, oregano, and raisins, and cook 2 minutes more.
Fill each dough round with beef mixture, fold over, and crimp edges to seal.
Brush with egg wash and bake 20-25 minutes until golden.

recipes.title: Argentine-Style Chimichurri Skirt Steak
recipes.ingredients:
1 1/2 lb skirt steak
1 cup chopped parsley
3 cloves garlic
2 tbsp red wine vinegar
1/2 cup olive oil
1/2 tsp red pepper flakes
Salt and pepper to taste
recipes.instructions:
Season steak generously with salt and pepper.
Blend parsley, garlic, vinegar, olive oil, and red pepper flakes for the chimichurri.
Grill or sear steak 3-4 minutes per side for medium-rare.
Let rest 5 minutes, then slice against the grain.
Spoon chimichurri over the sliced steak to serve.

recipes.title: Beef and Bean Chili Verde
recipes.ingredients:
1 1/2 lb beef stew meat, cubed
1 tbsp oil
1 onion, chopped
2 cloves garlic, minced
2 cups tomatillo salsa verde
1 can (15 oz) pinto beans, drained
1 cup beef broth
1 tsp dried oregano
recipes.instructions:
Heat oil in a pot and brown the beef; remove and set aside.
Cook onion until soft, then add garlic.
Stir in salsa verde, broth, and oregano, then return beef to the pot.
Cover and simmer 30-35 minutes until beef is tender.
Stir in pinto beans and simmer 5 more minutes before serving.

recipes.title: Turkey Tetrazzini
recipes.ingredients:
8 oz spaghetti, cooked
2 cups chopped cooked turkey
1 cup sliced mushrooms
3 tbsp butter
3 tbsp flour
2 cups chicken broth
1/2 cup milk
1/2 cup grated parmesan
1/2 cup shredded mozzarella
2 tbsp breadcrumbs
recipes.instructions:
Preheat oven to 375F.
Saute mushrooms in butter until browned, then whisk in flour and cook 1 minute.
Gradually whisk in broth and milk, simmering until thickened.
Stir in turkey, spaghetti, and parmesan, then transfer to a baking dish.
Top with mozzarella and breadcrumbs and bake 20-25 minutes until bubbly.

recipes.title: Turkey Pot Pie
recipes.ingredients:
1 pie crust, plus a top crust
2 cups chopped cooked turkey
3 tbsp butter
1 onion, diced
2 carrots, diced
1 cup diced potatoes
3 tbsp flour
2 cups chicken broth
1/2 cup milk
1 cup frozen green beans, corn, or diced squash
recipes.instructions:
Preheat oven to 400F and fit bottom crust into a pie dish.
Saute onion, carrots, and potatoes in butter until slightly softened.
Sprinkle in flour and cook 1 minute, then whisk in broth and milk until thickened.
Stir in turkey and green beans or squash, then pour filling into the crust.
Top with the second crust, crimp edges, cut vents, and bake 30-35 minutes until golden.

recipes.title: Salisbury Steak with Mushroom Gravy
recipes.ingredients:
1 lb ground beef
1/3 cup breadcrumbs
1 egg
1 tbsp Worcestershire sauce
2 tbsp oil
1 onion, sliced
2 cups sliced mushrooms
2 tbsp flour
2 cups beef broth
recipes.instructions:
Mix ground beef, breadcrumbs, egg, and Worcestershire sauce; shape into oval patties.
Heat oil in a skillet and brown patties on both sides; remove and set aside.
Cook onion and mushrooms in the same skillet until softened.
Sprinkle in flour and cook 1 minute, then whisk in broth until thickened.
Return patties to the skillet, simmer 10 minutes, and serve with the gravy.

recipes.title: Country-Fried Steak with Gravy
recipes.ingredients:
3 cube steaks
1 cup flour
1 tsp paprika
2 eggs, beaten with 2 tbsp milk
Oil for frying
2 tbsp flour, for gravy
2 cups milk
Salt and pepper to taste
recipes.instructions:
Season flour with paprika, salt, and pepper.
Dredge steaks in seasoned flour, then egg wash, then flour again.
Fry in hot oil 3-4 minutes per side until golden and cooked through; drain on paper towels.
Pour off most of the oil, leaving 2 tbsp with browned bits, and whisk in flour.
Gradually whisk in milk and simmer until thickened; season and serve over the steaks.

recipes.title: Turkey and Vegetable Shepherd's Pie
recipes.ingredients:
1 lb ground turkey
1 onion, diced
2 carrots, diced
1 cup diced zucchini
2 tbsp tomato paste
1 cup chicken broth
3 cups mashed potatoes
1/2 cup shredded cheddar
recipes.instructions:
Preheat oven to 400F.
Brown ground turkey with onion, carrots, and zucchini until vegetables soften.
Stir in tomato paste and broth, and simmer 10 minutes until slightly thickened.
Spread the meat mixture in a baking dish and top with mashed potatoes.
Sprinkle with cheddar and bake 20-25 minutes until golden.

recipes.title: Swedish Meatballs
recipes.ingredients:
1 lb ground beef
1/3 cup breadcrumbs
1/4 cup milk
1 egg
1/2 tsp allspice
3 tbsp butter
3 tbsp flour
2 cups beef broth
1/2 cup sour cream
Egg noodles for serving
recipes.instructions:
Soak breadcrumbs in milk, then mix with beef, egg, and allspice; shape into small meatballs.
Brown meatballs in butter in a skillet, working in batches; remove and set aside.
Whisk flour into the drippings and cook 1 minute, then whisk in broth until thickened.
Stir in sour cream, return meatballs to the pan, and simmer 5 minutes.
Serve over egg noodles.

recipes.title: German Sausage and Cabbage Skillet
recipes.ingredients:
1 tbsp oil
4 bratwurst sausages, sliced
1/2 head cabbage, shredded
1 onion, sliced
1 apple, sliced
2 tbsp apple cider vinegar
1 tbsp brown sugar
Salt and pepper to taste
recipes.instructions:
Heat oil in a skillet and brown sausage slices; remove and set aside.
Cook onion until softened, then add cabbage and apple, cooking until cabbage wilts, about 10 minutes.
Stir in vinegar and brown sugar.
Return sausage to the skillet and heat through before serving.

recipes.title: Pork Schnitzel
recipes.ingredients:
3 boneless pork chops, pounded thin
1/2 cup flour
2 eggs, beaten
1 1/2 cups breadcrumbs
Oil for frying
Lemon wedges for serving
recipes.instructions:
Dredge pork chops in flour, then egg, then breadcrumbs.
Fry in a shallow layer of hot oil until golden and cooked through, 3-4 minutes per side.
Drain on paper towels.
Serve with lemon wedges.

recipes.title: Chicken Cordon Bleu
recipes.ingredients:
3 chicken breasts, butterflied
3 slices ham
3 slices swiss cheese
1/2 cup flour
2 eggs, beaten
1 cup breadcrumbs
Oil for frying
recipes.instructions:
Lay ham and cheese inside each butterflied chicken breast and roll up, securing with toothpicks.
Dredge in flour, then egg, then breadcrumbs.
Heat oil in a skillet and brown the chicken on all sides.
Transfer to a 375F oven and bake 15-18 minutes until cooked through.
Remove toothpicks before slicing and serving.

recipes.title: Chicken Fricassee
recipes.ingredients:
6 chicken thighs
2 tbsp butter
1 onion, diced
1 cup sliced mushrooms
2 tbsp flour
2 cups chicken broth
1/2 cup heavy cream
1 tbsp lemon juice
2 tbsp chopped parsley
recipes.instructions:
Melt butter in a pot and brown chicken thighs; remove and set aside.
Cook onion and mushrooms until softened, then sprinkle in flour and cook 1 minute.
Gradually whisk in broth, then return chicken to the pot.
Cover and simmer 30-35 minutes until chicken is cooked through.
Stir in cream and lemon juice, garnish with parsley, and serve.

recipes.title: Ratatouille
recipes.ingredients:
2 tbsp olive oil
1 eggplant, cubed
2 zucchini, cubed
1 onion, sliced
3 cloves garlic, minced
1 can (28 oz) crushed tomatoes
1 tsp dried herbes de Provence
Fresh basil for garnish
recipes.instructions:
Heat olive oil in a large pot and cook eggplant until lightly browned; remove.
Cook zucchini until lightly browned; remove.
Cook onion until soft, then add garlic and cook 1 minute.
Stir in tomatoes and herbes de Provence, then return eggplant and zucchini to the pot.
Simmer uncovered 25-30 minutes until vegetables are tender and flavors meld.
Garnish with basil before serving.

recipes.title: Beef Daube Provencal
recipes.ingredients:
1 1/2 lb beef chuck, cubed
2 tbsp flour
2 tbsp olive oil
1 onion, diced
2 carrots, sliced
3 cloves garlic, minced
1 1/2 cups red wine
1 cup beef broth
1 can (15 oz) diced tomatoes
1 bay leaf
Orange zest strip
recipes.instructions:
Toss beef with flour and brown in olive oil in a Dutch oven; remove.
Cook onion and carrots until softened, then add garlic.
Stir in wine, broth, tomatoes, bay leaf, and orange zest, then return beef to the pot.
Cover and braise at 325F for 1 3/4 to 2 hours until beef is very tender.
Remove bay leaf and orange zest before serving.

recipes.title: Moussaka-Style Beef and Eggplant Bake
recipes.ingredients:
1 eggplant, sliced
2 tbsp olive oil
1 lb ground beef
1 onion, diced
2 cloves garlic, minced
1 can (15 oz) diced tomatoes
1 tsp cinnamon
3 tbsp butter
3 tbsp flour
1 1/2 cups milk
1/2 cup grated parmesan
recipes.instructions:
Brush eggplant slices with olive oil and roast at 400F for 15 minutes until softened.
Brown ground beef with onion and garlic, then stir in tomatoes and cinnamon; simmer 10 minutes.
Melt butter, whisk in flour, then gradually whisk in milk to make a bechamel; stir in parmesan.
Layer eggplant and beef mixture in a baking dish, top with bechamel.
Bake at 375F for 20-25 minutes until golden and bubbly.

recipes.title: Greek Baked Chicken with Lemon Potatoes
recipes.ingredients:
6 chicken thighs
4 potatoes, cut into wedges
1/4 cup olive oil
Juice of 2 lemons
3 cloves garlic, minced
1 tbsp dried oregano
1/2 cup chicken broth
recipes.instructions:
Preheat oven to 400F.
Toss chicken and potatoes with olive oil, lemon juice, garlic, and oregano in a baking dish.
Pour chicken broth around the chicken and potatoes.
Bake 40-45 minutes, basting occasionally, until chicken is cooked through and potatoes are tender and golden.

recipes.title: Beef Souvlaki Skewers with Tzatziki
recipes.ingredients:
1 1/2 lb beef sirloin, cubed
1/4 cup olive oil
2 tbsp lemon juice
2 cloves garlic, minced
1 tsp dried oregano
1 cup plain yogurt
1/2 cucumber, grated and squeezed dry
1 tbsp fresh dill, chopped
recipes.instructions:
Marinate beef in olive oil, lemon juice, garlic, and oregano for at least 20 minutes.
Thread beef onto skewers.
Mix yogurt, cucumber, and dill for the tzatziki.
Grill or broil skewers 3-4 minutes per side until cooked to your liking.
Serve with tzatziki sauce.

recipes.title: Chicken Vesuvio
recipes.ingredients:
6 chicken thighs
3 potatoes, quartered
4 cloves garlic, smashed
1/3 cup white wine
1/4 cup chicken broth
2 tbsp olive oil
1 tsp dried oregano
1/2 cup frozen or fresh green beans
recipes.instructions:
Preheat oven to 400F.
Brown chicken thighs and potatoes in olive oil in an oven-safe skillet.
Add garlic, wine, broth, and oregano.
Transfer to the oven and roast 30-35 minutes, adding green beans for the last 10 minutes, until chicken is cooked through and potatoes are tender.

recipes.title: Chicken Scarpariello
recipes.ingredients:
6 chicken thighs
2 Italian sausages, sliced
2 tbsp olive oil
3 cloves garlic, minced
1/2 cup chicken broth
1/4 cup white wine vinegar
2 tbsp honey
2 tbsp chopped parsley
recipes.instructions:
Heat oil in a skillet and brown chicken and sausage; remove and set aside.
Cook garlic briefly, then add broth, vinegar, and honey, scraping up browned bits.
Return chicken and sausage to the skillet, cover, and simmer 20-25 minutes until chicken is cooked through.
Garnish with parsley and serve.

recipes.title: Beef Ragu over Pappardelle
recipes.ingredients:
1 1/2 lb beef chuck, cubed
2 tbsp olive oil
1 onion, diced
1 carrot, diced
1 celery stalk, diced
3 cloves garlic, minced
1 cup red wine
1 can (28 oz) crushed tomatoes
1 bay leaf
8 oz pappardelle, cooked
Grated parmesan for serving
recipes.instructions:
Brown the beef in olive oil in a pot; remove and set aside.
Cook onion, carrot, and celery until softened, then add garlic.
Stir in wine and simmer 2 minutes, then add tomatoes, bay leaf, and beef.
Cover and simmer on low 1 3/4 to 2 hours until beef shreds easily.
Shred the beef into the sauce and serve over pappardelle with parmesan.

recipes.title: Chicken Cacciatore Sausage Skillet
recipes.ingredients:
4 Italian sausages, sliced
1 lb chicken thighs, cubed
1 onion, sliced
2 cloves garlic, minced
1 can (15 oz) diced tomatoes
1/2 cup chicken broth
1 cup sliced mushrooms
2 tbsp chopped basil
recipes.instructions:
Brown sausage and chicken in a large skillet; remove and set aside.
Cook onion until soft, then add garlic and mushrooms.
Stir in tomatoes and broth, then return sausage and chicken to the skillet.
Cover and simmer 25-30 minutes until chicken is cooked through.
Garnish with basil before serving.

recipes.title: Vegetable and White Bean Cassoulet
recipes.ingredients:
2 tbsp olive oil
1 onion, diced
2 carrots, diced
2 cloves garlic, minced
2 cans (15 oz) white beans, drained
1 can (15 oz) diced tomatoes
1 cup vegetable broth
1 bay leaf
1/2 cup breadcrumbs
2 tbsp chopped parsley
recipes.instructions:
Preheat oven to 375F.
Heat oil in an oven-safe pot and cook onion and carrots until softened, then add garlic.
Stir in beans, tomatoes, broth, and bay leaf; bring to a simmer.
Top with breadcrumbs and bake uncovered 25-30 minutes until bubbly and the top is golden.
Remove bay leaf and garnish with parsley before serving.

recipes.title: Duck-Style Braised Chicken Legs with Orange
recipes.ingredients:
6 chicken drumsticks
2 tbsp oil
1 onion, sliced
Zest and juice of 2 oranges
1/2 cup chicken broth
1 tbsp honey
1 tbsp soy sauce
2 tbsp chopped fresh thyme
recipes.instructions:
Heat oil in a skillet and brown chicken drumsticks on all sides; remove and set aside.
Cook onion until softened.
Stir in orange zest and juice, broth, honey, and soy sauce.
Return chicken to the skillet, cover, and simmer 35-40 minutes until cooked through and glazed.
Garnish with thyme before serving.

recipes.title: Chicken Korma
recipes.ingredients:
1 lb chicken thighs, cubed
1 tbsp oil
1 onion, diced
3 cloves garlic, minced
1 tbsp grated ginger
1 tbsp garam masala
1/2 tsp turmeric
1/2 cup plain yogurt
1/2 cup coconut milk
1/4 cup chopped cashews
2 cups cooked rice
recipes.instructions:
Heat oil in a pan and cook onion until golden, about 8 minutes.
Add garlic, ginger, garam masala, and turmeric, cooking 1 minute.
Stir in chicken and cook until lightly browned.
Add yogurt and coconut milk, cover, and simmer 20-25 minutes until chicken is cooked through.
Stir in cashews and serve over rice.

recipes.title: Saag Paneer
recipes.ingredients:
12 oz paneer, cubed
1 tbsp oil
1 onion, diced
3 cloves garlic, minced
1 tbsp grated ginger
1 tsp garam masala
1/2 tsp turmeric
10 oz baby spinach
1/4 cup heavy cream
2 cups cooked rice
recipes.instructions:
Heat oil in a skillet and fry paneer cubes until lightly golden; remove and set aside.
Cook onion until soft, then add garlic, ginger, garam masala, and turmeric.
Add spinach in batches, cooking until wilted.
Puree half the spinach mixture and return to the pan for a chunky-smooth texture.
Stir in cream and paneer, and simmer 5 minutes; serve over rice.

recipes.title: Chana Masala
recipes.ingredients:
2 tbsp oil
1 onion, diced
3 cloves garlic, minced
1 tbsp grated ginger
1 tbsp garam masala
1/2 tsp turmeric
2 cans (15 oz) chickpeas, drained
1 can (15 oz) diced tomatoes
1/4 cup chopped cilantro
2 cups cooked rice
recipes.instructions:
Heat oil in a pot and cook onion until golden.
Add garlic, ginger, garam masala, and turmeric, cooking 1 minute.
Stir in chickpeas and tomatoes, and simmer 20 minutes.
Mash some chickpeas against the pot to thicken.
Garnish with cilantro and serve over rice.

recipes.title: Butter Chicken
recipes.ingredients:
1 lb chicken thighs, cubed
1/2 cup plain yogurt
1 tbsp lemon juice
1 tsp paprika
3 tbsp butter
1 onion, diced
3 cloves garlic, minced
1 tbsp grated ginger
1 tbsp garam masala
1 can (15 oz) tomato sauce
1/2 cup heavy cream
2 cups cooked rice
recipes.instructions:
Marinate chicken in yogurt, lemon juice, and paprika for at least 15 minutes.
Melt butter in a pan and cook chicken until browned; remove and set aside.
Cook onion until soft, then add garlic, ginger, and garam masala.
Stir in tomato sauce and simmer 10 minutes, then return chicken and simmer until cooked through.
Stir in cream and serve over rice.

recipes.title: Lentil Dal with Rice
recipes.ingredients:
1 cup red lentils, rinsed
3 cups vegetable broth
1 tbsp oil
1 onion, diced
3 cloves garlic, minced
1 tbsp grated ginger
1 tsp turmeric
1 tsp garam masala
1 can (15 oz) diced tomatoes
2 cups cooked rice
Fresh cilantro for garnish
recipes.instructions:
Simmer lentils in broth until soft, about 20 minutes.
Heat oil in a separate pan and cook onion until soft, then add garlic, ginger, turmeric, and garam masala.
Stir in tomatoes and cook 5 minutes.
Combine the spiced tomato mixture with the cooked lentils and simmer 5 more minutes.
Garnish with cilantro and serve over rice.

recipes.title: Chicken Vindaloo
recipes.ingredients:
1 1/2 lb chicken thighs, cubed
1 tbsp oil
1 onion, diced
4 cloves garlic, minced
1 tbsp grated ginger
2 tsp paprika
1 tsp ground coriander
1/2 tsp cinnamon
2 tbsp red wine vinegar
1 can (15 oz) diced tomatoes
2 cups cooked rice
recipes.instructions:
Heat oil in a pan and brown chicken; remove and set aside.
Cook onion until softened, then add garlic, ginger, paprika, coriander, and cinnamon.
Stir in vinegar and tomatoes, then return chicken to the pan.
Cover and simmer 25-30 minutes until chicken is cooked through.
Serve over rice.

recipes.title: Vegetable Biryani
recipes.ingredients:
1 1/2 cups basmati rice
2 tbsp oil
1 onion, sliced
2 carrots, diced
1 cup cauliflower florets
1 cup green beans, cut
2 cloves garlic, minced
1 tbsp grated ginger
1 tbsp garam masala
1/2 tsp turmeric
2 1/2 cups vegetable broth
1/4 cup golden raisins
1/4 cup toasted cashews
recipes.instructions:
Rinse rice and set aside.
Heat oil in a large pot and cook onion until golden, about 8 minutes; remove half for garnish.
Add carrots, cauliflower, and green beans, cooking 5 minutes.
Stir in garlic, ginger, garam masala, and turmeric, then add rice and broth.
Bring to a boil, cover, and simmer 18-20 minutes until rice is tender.
Stir in raisins, top with reserved onion and cashews, and serve.

recipes.title: Beef Rendang-Style Curry
recipes.ingredients:
1 1/2 lb beef chuck, cubed
1 onion, chopped
3 cloves garlic
1 tbsp grated ginger
2 tsp paprika
1 tsp ground coriander
1 stalk lemongrass, smashed
1 can (14 oz) coconut milk
1 tbsp brown sugar
2 cups cooked rice
recipes.instructions:
Blend onion, garlic, ginger, paprika, and coriander into a paste.
Brown beef in a pot, then stir in the spice paste and cook 2 minutes.
Add lemongrass, coconut milk, and brown sugar.
Cover and simmer on low, stirring occasionally, 1 1/4 to 1 1/2 hours until beef is very tender and sauce has thickened and darkened.
Remove lemongrass stalk and serve over rice.

recipes.title: Chicken Satay Skewers with Peanut Sauce
recipes.ingredients:
