1 1/2 lb chicken thighs, cubed
2 tbsp soy sauce
1 tbsp brown sugar
1 tsp turmeric
1/3 cup peanut butter
1 tbsp soy sauce
1 tbsp lime juice
1 tsp brown sugar
1/4 cup coconut milk
recipes.instructions:
Marinate chicken in soy sauce, brown sugar, and turmeric for at least 20 minutes.
Thread chicken onto skewers.
Whisk peanut butter, soy sauce, lime juice, brown sugar, and coconut milk together for the sauce.
Grill or broil skewers 3-4 minutes per side until cooked through.
Serve with the peanut sauce for dipping.

recipes.title: Ginger Teriyaki Chicken and Broccoli Skillet
recipes.ingredients:
1 lb chicken thighs, cubed
1/4 cup soy sauce
2 tbsp mirin or rice vinegar with a pinch of sugar
2 tbsp brown sugar
1 tbsp grated ginger
2 cups cooked rice
1 cup steamed broccoli
Sesame seeds for garnish
recipes.instructions:
Whisk soy sauce, mirin, brown sugar, and ginger together.
Cook chicken in a hot skillet until browned, about 8 minutes.
Pour sauce over chicken and simmer until glossy and chicken is cooked through, about 5 minutes.
Serve over rice with steamed broccoli, garnished with sesame seeds.

recipes.title: Chicken Yakitori Skewers
recipes.ingredients:
1 1/2 lb chicken thighs, cubed
3 green onions, cut into 1-inch pieces
1/4 cup soy sauce
2 tbsp mirin or rice vinegar with a pinch of sugar
2 tbsp sake or water
1 tbsp brown sugar
recipes.instructions:
Simmer soy sauce, mirin, sake, and brown sugar in a small pot until slightly thickened, about 5 minutes.
Thread chicken and green onion pieces alternately onto skewers.
Grill or broil skewers, turning and basting with the glaze, until chicken is cooked through, about 10-12 minutes.

recipes.title: Beef Yakiniku Rice Bowls
recipes.ingredients:
1 lb thinly sliced beef short rib or sirloin
1/4 cup soy sauce
2 tbsp brown sugar
1 tbsp sesame oil
2 cloves garlic, minced
1 tbsp grated ginger
2 cups cooked rice
1 cup steamed spinach
Sesame seeds for garnish
recipes.instructions:
Whisk soy sauce, brown sugar, sesame oil, garlic, and ginger together and marinate beef for 15 minutes.
Cook beef in a hot skillet in batches until browned, 2-3 minutes.
Serve over rice with steamed spinach, garnished with sesame seeds.

recipes.title: Chicken Katsu Curry
recipes.ingredients:
3 chicken breasts, pounded thin
1/2 cup flour
2 eggs, beaten
1 1/2 cups panko
Oil for frying
1 onion, diced
2 carrots, diced
1 potato, diced
2 tbsp curry powder
2 tbsp flour
2 cups chicken broth
2 cups cooked rice
recipes.instructions:
Bread and fry the chicken as for katsu; slice and set aside.
Cook onion, carrots, and potato in a pot until softened.
Stir in curry powder and flour, cooking 1 minute, then gradually whisk in broth.
Simmer 15-20 minutes until vegetables are tender and sauce thickens.
Serve curry and sliced chicken over rice.

recipes.title: Vegetable Tempura with Dipping Sauce
recipes.ingredients:
1 sweet potato, sliced
1 zucchini, sliced
1 small onion, sliced into rings
1 cup flour
1 cup ice-cold water
1 egg
Oil for frying
1/4 cup soy sauce
1/4 cup dashi or vegetable broth
1 tbsp mirin or rice vinegar with sugar
recipes.instructions:
Whisk flour, ice water, and egg together lightly, leaving some lumps.
Heat oil to 350F in a deep pot.
Dip vegetables in batter and fry until light golden and crisp, a few minutes per batch.
Drain on paper towels.
Simmer soy sauce, dashi, and mirin together for the dipping sauce and serve alongside.

recipes.title: Chicken Teriyaki Meatballs
recipes.ingredients:
1 lb ground chicken
1/3 cup panko
1 egg
2 green onions, minced
1/4 cup soy sauce
3 tbsp brown sugar
1 tbsp rice vinegar
1 tbsp cornstarch mixed with 2 tbsp water
2 cups cooked rice
recipes.instructions:
Preheat oven to 400F and mix ground chicken, panko, egg, and green onion; shape into meatballs.
Bake 18-20 minutes until cooked through.
Simmer soy sauce, brown sugar, and rice vinegar in a saucepan, then stir in the cornstarch slurry until thickened.
Toss meatballs in the glaze and serve over rice.

recipes.title: Beef and Broccoli Udon
recipes.ingredients:
2 packs udon noodles
1 lb flank steak, sliced thin
2 cups broccoli florets
1/4 cup soy sauce
2 tbsp mushroom stir-fry sauce
1 tbsp brown sugar
2 cloves garlic, minced
1 tbsp sesame oil
recipes.instructions:
Cook udon according to package directions and drain.
Heat sesame oil in a wok and stir-fry beef until browned; remove.
Stir-fry broccoli and garlic 3-4 minutes until crisp-tender.
Whisk soy sauce, mushroom sauce, and brown sugar together and add to the wok with beef and noodles.
Toss everything together until heated through and serve.

recipes.title: Honey Sriracha Chicken Thighs
recipes.ingredients:
6 chicken thighs
3 tbsp honey
2 tbsp sriracha
1 tbsp soy sauce
2 cloves garlic, minced
1 tbsp oil
2 tbsp chopped green onion
recipes.instructions:
Preheat oven to 400F.
Whisk honey, sriracha, soy sauce, garlic, and oil together.
Toss chicken thighs in the sauce and arrange in a baking dish.
Bake 25-30 minutes, basting once, until cooked through and caramelized.
Garnish with green onion before serving.

recipes.title: Smothered Pork Chops
recipes.ingredients:
3 bone-in pork chops
2 tbsp oil
1 onion, sliced
2 tbsp flour
2 cups chicken broth
1/4 cup milk
Salt and pepper to taste
recipes.instructions:
Season pork chops with salt and pepper and brown in oil in a skillet; remove and set aside.
Cook onion in the same skillet until softened.
Sprinkle in flour and cook 1 minute, then whisk in broth and milk until thickened.
Return pork chops to the skillet, cover, and simmer 20-25 minutes until tender.
Serve chops smothered in the gravy.

recipes.title: Chicken Fried Steak Sandwiches
recipes.ingredients:
3 cube steaks
1 cup flour
2 eggs, beaten with 2 tbsp milk
Oil for frying
3 hamburger buns
3 lettuce leaves
3 tomato slices
1/4 cup mayonnaise
recipes.instructions:
Dredge steaks in flour, then egg wash, then flour again.
Fry in hot oil 3-4 minutes per side until golden and cooked through.
Toast the buns and spread with mayonnaise.
Assemble sandwiches with fried steak, lettuce, and tomato.

recipes.title: Baked Turkey Meatball Subs Marinara
recipes.ingredients:
1 lb ground turkey
1/3 cup breadcrumbs
1 egg
2 tbsp grated parmesan
2 cups marinara sauce
3 sub rolls
1 cup shredded mozzarella
recipes.instructions:
Preheat oven to 400F and mix turkey, breadcrumbs, egg, and parmesan; shape into meatballs.
Bake 15-18 minutes until cooked through.
Simmer meatballs in marinara sauce 5 minutes.
Fill rolls with meatballs and sauce, top with mozzarella, and broil until melted.

recipes.title: Chicken Fajita Sheet Pan Dinner
recipes.ingredients:
1 1/2 lb chicken breast, sliced thin
2 zucchini, sliced
1 red onion, sliced
2 tbsp oil
2 tsp chili powder
1 tsp smoked paprika
1 tsp garlic powder
Warm tortillas and lime wedges for serving
recipes.instructions:
Preheat oven to 425F.
Toss chicken, zucchini, and onion with oil and spices on a sheet pan.
Spread in a single layer and roast 18-20 minutes, stirring halfway, until chicken is cooked through.
Serve with warm tortillas and lime wedges.

recipes.title: Slow Cooker Pork Carnitas
recipes.ingredients:
2 lb pork shoulder
1 onion, quartered
4 cloves garlic
1 orange, juiced
1 tsp dried oregano
1 tsp smoked paprika
Corn tortillas and lime for serving
recipes.instructions:
Place pork, onion, garlic, orange juice, oregano, and paprika in a slow cooker.
Cook on low 8 hours or high 4 hours until pork shreds easily.
Shred the pork and toss with some of the cooking liquid.
Crisp shredded pork under a broiler for a few minutes if desired.
Serve with warm tortillas and lime.

recipes.title: Beef Enchilada Skillet
recipes.ingredients:
1 lb ground beef
1 onion, diced
2 cups enchilada sauce
6 corn tortillas, torn into pieces
1 cup shredded cheese
1/4 cup chopped cilantro
recipes.instructions:
Brown ground beef with onion in a large oven-safe skillet.
Stir in enchilada sauce and torn tortillas, tossing to coat.
Simmer 5 minutes, then top with cheese.
Broil 2-3 minutes until cheese melts and bubbles.
Garnish with cilantro before serving.

recipes.title: Chicken Enchilada Verde Bake
recipes.ingredients:
8 corn tortillas
2 cups shredded cooked chicken
2 cups tomatillo salsa verde
1 cup sour cream
2 cups shredded Monterey jack cheese
1/4 cup chopped cilantro
recipes.instructions:
Preheat oven to 375F.
Mix half the salsa verde with sour cream and toss with the chicken.
Fill tortillas with the chicken mixture, roll, and place seam-side down in a baking dish.
Pour remaining salsa verde over the top and sprinkle with cheese.
Bake 20-25 minutes until bubbly; garnish with cilantro.

recipes.title: Beef Barbacoa
recipes.ingredients:
2 lb beef chuck roast
2 chipotle peppers in adobo, minced
4 cloves garlic
1 tbsp red wine vinegar
1 tsp dried oregano
1 cup beef broth
2 cups cooked rice or warm tortillas
recipes.instructions:
Combine beef, chipotles, garlic, vinegar, oregano, and broth in a slow cooker or Dutch oven.
Cook on low in a slow cooker 8 hours, or braise covered at 300F for 3 hours, until beef shreds easily.
Shred the beef and mix with some of the cooking liquid.
Serve over rice or in warm tortillas.

recipes.title: Chicken Verde Enchilada Casserole
recipes.ingredients:
10 corn tortillas, cut into strips
2 cups shredded cooked chicken
2 cups tomatillo salsa verde
1 cup Mexican crema or sour cream
2 cups shredded cheese
recipes.instructions:
Preheat oven to 375F.
Layer tortilla strips, chicken, salsa verde, crema, and cheese in a baking dish, repeating layers.
Top with remaining cheese.
Bake 25-30 minutes until bubbly and golden.

recipes.title: Chicken Chile Relleno Casserole
recipes.ingredients:
4 poblano peppers, roasted, peeled, and seeded
2 cups shredded cooked chicken
2 cups shredded cheese
4 eggs
1 cup milk
1/3 cup flour
1/2 tsp baking powder
recipes.instructions:
Preheat oven to 375F and grease a baking dish.
Lay roasted poblanos flat in the dish and fill with chicken and half the cheese.
Whisk eggs, milk, flour, and baking powder together and pour over the poblanos.
Top with remaining cheese and bake 30-35 minutes until set and golden.

recipes.title: Beef and Bean Burrito Bake
recipes.ingredients:
6 large flour tortillas
1 lb ground beef
1 packet taco seasoning
1 can (15 oz) refried beans
2 cups enchilada sauce
2 cups shredded cheese
recipes.instructions:
Preheat oven to 375F.
Brown ground beef and stir in taco seasoning and refried beans.
Fill tortillas with the beef mixture, roll, and place in a baking dish.
Pour enchilada sauce over the top and sprinkle with cheese.
Bake 25-30 minutes until bubbly.

recipes.title: Chicken Sausage and White Bean Bake
recipes.ingredients:
4 chicken sausages, sliced
2 cans (15 oz) white beans, drained
1 onion, sliced
2 cloves garlic, minced
1 cup diced tomatoes
1/2 cup chicken broth
2 tbsp olive oil
Fresh rosemary for garnish
recipes.instructions:
Preheat oven to 400F.
Toss sausage, beans, onion, garlic, tomatoes, broth, and olive oil together in a baking dish.
Bake 25-30 minutes until sausage is browned and mixture is bubbly.
Garnish with rosemary before serving.

recipes.title: Turkey Chili Verde
recipes.ingredients:
1 lb ground turkey
1 tbsp oil
1 onion, diced
2 cloves garlic, minced
2 cups tomatillo salsa verde
1 can (15 oz) white beans, drained
1 cup chicken broth
1/4 cup chopped cilantro
recipes.instructions:
Heat oil in a pot and brown ground turkey with onion and garlic.
Stir in salsa verde, beans, and broth.
Simmer uncovered 25-30 minutes until slightly thickened.
Garnish with cilantro before serving.

recipes.title: Beef Stroganoff Meatballs
recipes.ingredients:
1 lb ground beef
1/3 cup breadcrumbs
1 egg
2 tbsp oil
1 onion, diced
2 cups sliced mushrooms
2 tbsp flour
2 cups beef broth
1/2 cup sour cream
Egg noodles for serving
recipes.instructions:
Mix ground beef, breadcrumbs, and egg; shape into meatballs and brown in oil, then set aside.
Cook onion and mushrooms in the same pan until softened.
Sprinkle in flour and cook 1 minute, then whisk in broth until thickened.
Return meatballs to the pan, stir in sour cream, and simmer 5 minutes.
Serve over egg noodles.

recipes.title: Chicken and Wild Rice Skillet
recipes.ingredients:
1 1/2 lb chicken thighs, cubed
1 tbsp oil
1 onion, diced
2 carrots, diced
1 cup wild rice blend
3 cups chicken broth
1/2 cup sliced mushrooms
2 tbsp chopped parsley
recipes.instructions:
Heat oil in a skillet and brown chicken; remove and set aside.
Cook onion and carrots until softened.
Stir in wild rice and broth, then return chicken to the skillet.
Cover and simmer 30-35 minutes until rice is tender, adding mushrooms in the last 10 minutes.
Garnish with parsley before serving.

recipes.title: Honey Garlic Pork Tenderloin Skillet
recipes.ingredients:
1 1/2 lb pork tenderloin, sliced into medallions
2 tbsp oil
1/4 cup honey
3 tbsp soy sauce
3 cloves garlic, minced
1 tbsp rice vinegar
recipes.instructions:
Heat oil in a skillet and brown pork medallions 2-3 minutes per side; remove and set aside.
Whisk honey, soy sauce, garlic, and vinegar together and add to the skillet.
Simmer until slightly thickened, about 2 minutes.
Return pork to the skillet and toss to coat before serving.

recipes.title: Chicken and Chorizo Skillet with Rice
recipes.ingredients:
1 lb chicken thighs, cubed
1/2 lb Spanish chorizo, sliced
1 onion, diced
2 cloves garlic, minced
1 1/2 cups rice
1/2 tsp smoked paprika
3 cups chicken broth
1 cup canned diced tomatoes
recipes.instructions:
Brown chicken and chorizo in a skillet; remove and set aside.
Cook onion until soft, then add garlic and paprika.
Stir in rice, broth, and tomatoes, then return chicken and chorizo to the skillet.
Cover and simmer 20-25 minutes until rice is tender.

recipes.title: Sheet Pan Sausage, Sweet Potato, and Zucchini
recipes.ingredients:
4 Italian sausages, sliced
2 sweet potatoes, cubed
2 zucchini, sliced
2 tbsp olive oil
1 tsp dried rosemary
Salt and pepper to taste
recipes.instructions:
Preheat oven to 425F.
Toss sausage, sweet potatoes, and zucchini with olive oil, rosemary, salt, and pepper on a sheet pan.
Spread in a single layer and roast 25-30 minutes, stirring halfway, until vegetables are tender and sausage is browned.

recipes.title: Chicken Provencal
recipes.ingredients:
6 chicken thighs
2 tbsp olive oil
1 onion, sliced
3 cloves garlic, minced
1 can (15 oz) diced tomatoes
1/2 cup white wine
1 tsp herbes de Provence
2 tbsp chopped parsley
recipes.instructions:
Heat oil in a skillet and brown chicken thighs; remove and set aside.
Cook onion until softened, then add garlic and herbes de Provence.
Stir in tomatoes and wine, then return chicken to the skillet.
Cover and simmer 25-30 minutes until chicken is cooked through.
Garnish with parsley before serving.

recipes.title: Chicken and Dumplings
recipes.ingredients:
1 1/2 lb chicken thighs
1 onion, diced
2 carrots, diced
2 celery stalks, diced
4 cups chicken broth
1 cup flour
1 1/2 tsp baking powder
1/2 tsp salt
3/4 cup milk
2 tbsp melted butter
recipes.instructions:
Simmer chicken, onion, carrots, celery, and broth in a large pot 25 minutes until chicken is cooked through.
Remove chicken, shred, and return to the pot.
Mix flour, baking powder, salt, milk, and melted butter into a soft dough.
Drop spoonfuls of dough into the simmering broth.
Cover and simmer 12-15 minutes until dumplings are cooked through.

recipes.title: Baked Sweet Potato Chips
recipes.ingredients:
2 sweet potatoes, thinly sliced
2 tbsp olive oil
1/2 tsp salt
1/4 tsp smoked paprika
recipes.instructions:
Preheat oven to 400F and line two baking sheets with parchment.
Toss sweet potato slices with olive oil, salt, and paprika.
Arrange in a single layer and bake 10 minutes, flip, then bake 8-10 more minutes until crisp at the edges.
Cool slightly before serving; they crisp further as they cool.

recipes.title: Homemade Trail Mix Bars
recipes.ingredients:
2 cups rolled oats
1/2 cup honey
1/3 cup peanut butter
1/2 cup chopped almonds
1/3 cup dried cranberries
1/4 cup mini chocolate chips
1/2 tsp salt
recipes.instructions:
Warm honey and peanut butter together in a saucepan until smooth.
Stir in oats, almonds, cranberries, and salt until well coated.
Let cool slightly, then fold in chocolate chips.
Press firmly into a lined 8-inch pan and refrigerate 1 hour before cutting into bars.

recipes.title: Spiced Roasted Chickpeas
recipes.ingredients:
2 cans (15 oz) chickpeas, drained and dried well
2 tbsp olive oil
1 tsp smoked paprika
1/2 tsp garlic powder
1/2 tsp salt
recipes.instructions:
Preheat oven to 400F.
Toss chickpeas with olive oil, paprika, garlic powder, and salt.
Spread on a baking sheet in a single layer.
Roast 25-30 minutes, shaking the pan occasionally, until crispy.

recipes.title: Caprese Skewer Bites with Balsamic Drizzle
recipes.ingredients:
12 cherry tomatoes
12 mini mozzarella balls
12 fresh basil leaves
2 tbsp balsamic glaze
1 tbsp olive oil
recipes.instructions:
Thread a cherry tomato, folded basil leaf, and mozzarella ball onto small skewers.
Arrange on a platter.
Drizzle with balsamic glaze and olive oil just before serving.

recipes.title: Baked Zucchini Chips with Parmesan
recipes.ingredients:
2 zucchini, thinly sliced
2 tbsp olive oil
1/3 cup grated parmesan
1/2 tsp garlic powder
Salt to taste
recipes.instructions:
Preheat oven to 400F and pat zucchini slices dry.
Toss with olive oil, parmesan, garlic powder, and salt.
Arrange in a single layer on a lined baking sheet.
Bake 20-25 minutes until golden and crisp.

recipes.title: Homemade Soft Pretzels
recipes.ingredients:
1 1/2 cups warm water
1 packet active dry yeast
1 tbsp sugar
1 tsp salt
4 cups flour
1/4 cup baking soda mixed with 8 cups water
Coarse salt for topping
2 tbsp melted butter
recipes.instructions:
Dissolve yeast and sugar in warm water and let sit 5 minutes until foamy.
Mix in salt and flour to form a dough; knead 5 minutes until smooth.
Let rise 30 minutes, then divide into 6 pieces and shape into pretzels.
Boil each pretzel briefly in the baking soda water, then place on a lined sheet.
Sprinkle with coarse salt and bake at 425F for 12-15 minutes until golden.
Brush with melted butter before serving.

recipes.title: Cucumber and Cream Cheese Roll-Ups
recipes.ingredients:
1 cucumber
6 oz cream cheese, softened
2 tbsp chopped fresh dill
6 slices deli ham or turkey
recipes.instructions:
Use a vegetable peeler to cut long thin ribbons from the cucumber.
Mix cream cheese with dill.
Spread cream cheese onto each slice of ham or turkey and top with a cucumber ribbon.
Roll up tightly and secure with a toothpick.

recipes.title: Baked Cinnamon Apple Chips
recipes.ingredients:
3 apples, very thinly sliced
1 tsp cinnamon
1 tbsp sugar
recipes.instructions:
Preheat oven to 225F and line two baking sheets with parchment.
Toss apple slices with cinnamon and sugar.
Arrange in a single layer without overlapping.
Bake 1 1/2 to 2 hours, flipping halfway, until dry and crisp.
Cool completely before storing; they crisp further as they cool.

recipes.title: Loaded Baked Potato Bites
recipes.ingredients:
12 mini potatoes, halved and hollowed slightly
2 tbsp olive oil
1/2 cup shredded cheddar
3 slices bacon, cooked and crumbled
2 tbsp sour cream
1 tbsp chopped chives
recipes.instructions:
Preheat oven to 400F and toss potato halves with olive oil.
Roast cut-side down 15-18 minutes until tender and golden.
Flip, top with cheddar and bacon, and bake 3-5 more minutes until cheese melts.
Top with a small dollop of sour cream and chives before serving.

recipes.title: Peanut Butter Banana Bites
recipes.ingredients:
2 bananas, sliced into rounds
1/3 cup peanut butter
2 tbsp mini chocolate chips
2 tbsp chopped peanuts
recipes.instructions:
Spread a small dab of peanut butter on half the banana rounds.
Top with the remaining rounds to make sandwiches.
Press edges into chocolate chips and chopped peanuts.
Serve immediately or freeze briefly for a firmer texture.

recipes.title: Homemade Fruit Leather
recipes.ingredients:
3 cups chopped strawberries
1 apple, peeled and chopped
2 tbsp honey
1 tbsp lemon juice
recipes.instructions:
Preheat oven to 170F or its lowest setting and line a sheet pan with a silicone mat.
Puree strawberries, apple, honey, and lemon juice until smooth.
Spread thinly and evenly onto the lined pan.
Bake 3-4 hours, or until no longer sticky in the center.
Cool completely, then cut into strips and roll up.

recipes.title: Everything Bagel Cream Cheese Dip
recipes.ingredients:
8 oz cream cheese, softened
2 tbsp sour cream
1 tbsp everything bagel seasoning
Sliced vegetables and crackers for serving
recipes.instructions:
Beat cream cheese and sour cream together until smooth.
Stir in most of the everything bagel seasoning.
Transfer to a serving bowl and sprinkle remaining seasoning on top.
Serve with sliced vegetables and crackers.

recipes.title: Baked Parmesan Chickpea Fritters
recipes.ingredients:
1 can (15 oz) chickpeas, drained and mashed
1/4 cup grated parmesan
1 egg
2 tbsp flour
1 tbsp chopped parsley
Salt and pepper to taste
recipes.instructions:
Preheat oven to 400F and line a baking sheet.
Mix mashed chickpeas, parmesan, egg, flour, and parsley together.
Shape into small patties and place on the sheet.
Bake 10 minutes, flip, and bake 8-10 more minutes until golden.

recipes.title: Honey Mustard Pretzel Dip
recipes.ingredients:
1/2 cup mayonnaise
3 tbsp Dijon mustard
2 tbsp honey
1 tsp apple cider vinegar
Pretzels for dipping
recipes.instructions:
Whisk mayonnaise, mustard, honey, and vinegar together until smooth.
Chill 10 minutes to let flavors meld.
Serve with pretzels for dipping.

recipes.title: Mini Turkey Meatball Bites with Marinara
recipes.ingredients:
1/2 lb ground turkey
1/4 cup breadcrumbs
1 egg
2 tbsp grated parmesan
1 cup marinara sauce for dipping
recipes.instructions:
Preheat oven to 400F and mix turkey, breadcrumbs, egg, and parmesan.
Shape into small bite-sized meatballs.
Bake 15-18 minutes until cooked through.
Warm the marinara sauce and serve alongside for dipping.

recipes.title: Cheesy Baked Pita Chips with Herbs
recipes.ingredients:
3 pita breads, cut into wedges
3 tbsp olive oil
1/4 cup grated parmesan
1 tsp dried oregano
1/2 tsp garlic powder
recipes.instructions:
Preheat oven to 375F.
Toss pita wedges with olive oil, parmesan, oregano, and garlic powder.
Spread in a single layer on a baking sheet.
Bake 8-10 minutes until golden and crisp.

recipes.title: Frozen Yogurt Bark with Berries
recipes.ingredients:
2 cups vanilla Greek yogurt
2 tbsp honey
1 cup mixed berries, sliced
2 tbsp granola
1 tbsp mini chocolate chips
recipes.instructions:
Mix yogurt with honey and spread evenly onto a lined baking sheet.
Scatter berries, granola, and chocolate chips over the top.
Freeze at least 3 hours until solid.
Break into pieces and serve immediately, or store in the freezer.

recipes.title: Buffalo Chicken Dip
recipes.ingredients:
2 cups shredded cooked chicken
8 oz cream cheese, softened
1/2 cup ranch dressing
1/2 cup buffalo sauce
1 cup shredded cheddar
Celery sticks and crackers for serving
recipes.instructions:
Preheat oven to 375F.
Mix chicken, cream cheese, ranch dressing, and buffalo sauce together.
Spread into a baking dish and top with cheddar.
Bake 18-20 minutes until bubbly.
Serve warm with celery sticks and crackers.

recipes.title: Crispy Baked Zucchini Tots
recipes.ingredients:
2 cups grated zucchini, squeezed dry
1/2 cup breadcrumbs
1/3 cup shredded cheddar
1 egg
1/4 tsp garlic powder
Salt and pepper to taste
recipes.instructions:
Preheat oven to 400F and line a baking sheet.
Combine zucchini, breadcrumbs, cheddar, egg, garlic powder, salt, and pepper.
Shape into small tot shapes and place on the sheet.
Bake 12 minutes, flip, and bake 10-13 more minutes until golden and crisp.

recipes.title: Toasted Coconut Granola Clusters
recipes.ingredients:
2 cups rolled oats
1/2 cup shredded coconut
1/3 cup honey
3 tbsp coconut oil, melted
1/4 cup chopped almonds
1/4 tsp salt
recipes.instructions:
Preheat oven to 325F and line a baking sheet.
Mix oats, coconut, honey, coconut oil, almonds, and salt together, pressing into clumps.
Spread onto the sheet in small clusters.
Bake 18-20 minutes, stirring once, until golden.
Cool completely before breaking apart; clusters crisp as they cool.

recipes.title: Tiramisu Cups
recipes.ingredients:
24 ladyfinger cookies
1 1/2 cups strong brewed coffee, cooled
8 oz mascarpone cheese
1 cup heavy cream
1/3 cup sugar
1 tsp vanilla extract
Cocoa powder for dusting
recipes.instructions:
Whip heavy cream, sugar, and vanilla to soft peaks, then fold in mascarpone until smooth.
Quickly dip ladyfingers in coffee and layer in the bottom of small cups.
Top with a layer of the mascarpone mixture.
Repeat layers, ending with cream on top.
Dust with cocoa powder and refrigerate at least 2 hours before serving.

recipes.title: Churros with Cinnamon Sugar
recipes.ingredients:
1 cup water
1/4 cup butter
1 tbsp sugar
1/4 tsp salt
1 cup flour
2 eggs
Oil for frying
1/3 cup sugar mixed with 1 tsp cinnamon
recipes.instructions:
Bring water, butter, sugar, and salt to a boil, then stir in flour until a dough forms.
Cool slightly, then beat in eggs one at a time until smooth and glossy.
Pipe strips of dough into hot oil and fry until golden, about 3-4 minutes.
Drain and roll immediately in cinnamon sugar.

recipes.title: Chocolate Souffle
recipes.ingredients:
3 tbsp butter, plus more for ramekins
3 tbsp flour
1/2 cup milk
4 oz dark chocolate, melted
3 eggs, separated
1/4 cup sugar
Powdered sugar for dusting
recipes.instructions:
Preheat oven to 375F and butter three ramekins.
Melt butter, whisk in flour, then gradually add milk to make a thick base; stir in melted chocolate and egg yolks.
Beat egg whites with sugar to stiff peaks.
Fold egg whites gently into the chocolate base in three additions.
Divide among ramekins and bake 12-15 minutes until risen.
Dust with powdered sugar and serve immediately.

recipes.title: Baklava-Style Walnut Pastry Bites
recipes.ingredients:
1 package phyllo dough, thawed
1 1/2 cups chopped walnuts
1/2 tsp cinnamon
3/4 cup butter, melted
2/3 cup honey
1/4 cup water
1 tbsp lemon juice
recipes.instructions:
Preheat oven to 350F and mix walnuts with cinnamon.
Layer sheets of phyllo in a greased pan, brushing each with melted butter, using about a third of the sheets.
Sprinkle with half the walnut mixture, add more phyllo layers, then remaining walnuts, then top with remaining phyllo, buttering each layer.
Cut into small diamond shapes before baking.
Bake 30-35 minutes until golden.
Simmer honey, water, and lemon juice together and pour over the hot pastry.

recipes.title: Flan (Caramel Custard)
recipes.ingredients:
3/4 cup sugar
3 eggs
1 can (14 oz) sweetened condensed milk
1 cup whole milk
1 tsp vanilla extract
recipes.instructions:
Melt sugar in a saucepan over medium heat until amber, then pour into ramekins, swirling to coat the bottom.
Whisk eggs, condensed milk, whole milk, and vanilla together and pour over the caramel.
Place ramekins in a water bath and bake at 350F for 40-45 minutes until just set.
Cool completely, then refrigerate several hours.
Run a knife around the edge and invert onto plates to serve.

recipes.title: Mango Sticky Rice
recipes.ingredients:
1 cup glutinous rice, soaked 1 hour
1 cup coconut milk
3 tbsp sugar
1/4 tsp salt
2 ripe mangoes, sliced
1 tbsp toasted sesame seeds
recipes.instructions:
Steam the soaked rice over simmering water for 20-25 minutes until tender.
Warm coconut milk with sugar and salt, reserving a few tablespoons for drizzling.
Stir most of the coconut milk mixture into the warm rice and let sit 10 minutes to absorb.
Serve rice with sliced mango, drizzled with reserved coconut milk and sesame seeds.

recipes.title: Basque Burnt Cheesecake
recipes.ingredients:
32 oz cream cheese, softened
1 1/3 cups sugar
5 eggs
2 cups heavy cream
1 tsp vanilla extract
3 tbsp flour
1/4 tsp salt
recipes.instructions:
Preheat oven to 425F and line a springform pan with parchment, letting it rise above the rim.
Beat cream cheese and sugar until smooth, then beat in eggs one at a time.
Mix in cream, vanilla, flour, and salt until just combined.
Pour into the pan and bake 45-50 minutes until deeply browned on top and jiggly in the center.
Cool completely before slicing; the center will settle as it cools.

recipes.title: Sticky Toffee Pudding
recipes.ingredients:
1 cup chopped dates
1 cup boiling water
1 tsp baking soda
1 1/2 cups flour
1 tsp baking powder
1/2 cup butter, softened
2/3 cup brown sugar
2 eggs
1 cup brown sugar for sauce
1/2 cup heavy cream for sauce
1/4 cup butter for sauce
recipes.instructions:
Preheat oven to 350F and grease a baking dish.
Pour boiling water over dates and stir in baking soda; let sit 10 minutes, then puree.
Beat butter and brown sugar until fluffy, then beat in eggs.
Fold in flour, baking powder, and the date puree until combined.
Pour into the dish and bake 30-35 minutes until a toothpick comes out clean.
Simmer brown sugar, cream, and butter for the sauce until thickened, and pour warm sauce over the pudding before serving.

recipes.title: Affogato
recipes.ingredients:
3 scoops vanilla ice cream
3/4 cup hot espresso or strong coffee
Shaved chocolate for garnish
recipes.instructions:
Place a scoop of vanilla ice cream in each serving glass.
Pour hot espresso directly over the ice cream just before serving.
Garnish with shaved chocolate and serve immediately.

recipes.title: Baked Pears with Honey and Walnuts
recipes.ingredients:
3 ripe pears, halved and cored
3 tbsp honey
1/4 cup chopped walnuts
1 tsp cinnamon
2 tbsp butter, cubed
Vanilla ice cream for serving, optional
recipes.instructions:
Preheat oven to 375F and arrange pear halves cut-side up in a baking dish.
Drizzle with honey and sprinkle with walnuts and cinnamon.
Dot with butter.
Bake 20-25 minutes until pears are tender and lightly caramelized.
Serve warm, with vanilla ice cream if desired.
